pages.title: 论述型作文-亮点句式名词性从句
pages.path: 英语/写作/论述型作文-亮点句式名词性从句.md
pages.text: <h2 align="center" 论述型作文·亮点句式——名词性从句</h2 本讲核心 ：陈述事实、表达观点、提出问题 → 用 名词性从句 （主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句、同位语从句）。亮点有二： what 双从框架 （What...is that...）与 形式主语句式 （It is + a. + 从句/to do），后者可多层嵌套，是论述文"建议、要求"类语句的高级载体。 （一）为什么是名词性从句 语义逻辑决定句式选择： 陈述事实 / 表达观点 / 提出问题 这三类语义，对应句式工具就是名词性从句——一个"大句子套小句子"的结构，小句子（从句）整体充当大句子的一个名词性成分。 四种从句 （按从句充当的成分命名）： 从句类型 充当成分 典型场景 :--- :--- :--- 主语从句 大句子的主语 What we lack is ... 宾语从句 vt. 或介词后 We can see that ... 表语从句 be / 半系动词后 The problem is that ... 同位语从句 解释说明名词 a problem that ... / the conclusion that ... （二）引导词与四种常用结构 常用结构形式（4 种） ： 序号 结构 说明 :--- :--- :--- 1 that / whether + 完整句子 that 无实义不作成分；whether 表"是否" 2 what / which / who + 非完整句子 连接代词在从句中作成分；what = the thing that 3 when / where / why / how + 完整句子 连接副词作状语 4 how + adj./adv. + 主 + 谓 表感叹程度："多么好/坏/大/重要" 两条注意 ： 1. 主语从句的引导词不能省略 （That he came is true. 的 that 不可丢） 2. 特殊疑问词引导从句，语序一律用陈述语序 （不是疑问语序） 考点 ：主语从句作主语时，谓语用 单数 （主谓一致）——What we lack is the awareness of environmental protection. （三）形式主语句式（亮点句式） 形式主语句式表 建议、要求 类语义，两套模板： 1. It is + a. + (for/of) sb to do sth. 2. It is + a. + 主语从句 （eg. that sb (should) do sth.） 易错点 ：表人的品质的形容词（kind、shortsighted、wise...）用 of sb ；一般形容词用 for sb 。 虚拟语气 ：necessary/essential/advisable 等"建议要求"类形容词后的 that 从句用 (should) + 动词原形 ，should 可省。 （四）写作例题精讲（8 例） 一、图表/图画描述句 例 1 ：从这个表格中，我们可以看出国产车品牌所占市场份额大幅度增加。 - 拆解：中文是"大句子套小句子"——主干谓语"看出"（see vt.），"份额大幅增加"是陈述事实 → 宾语从句（that + 句子） - 词块：市场份额 market share （share 持有 → shareholder 股东）；国产品牌车 cars of national/domestic brands ；大幅度（地） dramatically/greatly - 基础版：From the table, we can see that the market share of cars of national brands has increased dramatically. - what 升级版（主从 + 表从）： What we can see from the table is that the market share of cars of national brands has increased dramatically. - 再嵌套定从（"所占"份额）：What we can see from the table is that the market share that cars of national brands take has increased dramatically.（take share 占份额） 技巧 ："我们可以看出"两种写法——宾从版（we can see that）与主从+表从版（What ... is that ...），后者句首即亮点。 例 2 ：这幅画显然在说中国正面临着性别比例失衡的问题。 - 词转换："说" → " 反映/体现 " reflect（板书补充 indicate） - 句式 1（主谓宾 + 同位语从句）： Obviously, the picture reflects a problem that China is faced with the imbalance of sex/gender ratio . - 句式 2（形式主语）： It is obvious that the picture reflects a problem that China is faced with the imbalance of sex/gender ratio. 例 3 ：我们应该采取措施保持生态平衡。 - It is necessary/essential that we (should) take measures to maintain ecological balance . - 要点："应该" → that 从句 + (should) 虚拟语气。 二、观点/哲理句 例 4 ：因此，生活中重要的是我们为别人做了什么。 - What(主语从句) is important in life is what(表语从句) we have done for others . - 词升级：be important = count (vi.)（如 Every minute counts. 分秒必争） 技巧 ：一句话装两个名词性从句——主语从句 + 表语从句，"……的是……"类哲理句的固定框架。 例 5 ：我们可以得出这样的结论：那些认为他们的成功可以以对手的失败为代价而获得的人是目光短浅的。 - 拆主干：We can come to the conclusion: ....；从句主干：那些……的人是目光短浅的（those people are shortsighted） - 基础版：We can come to / draw the conclusion that(同位语从句) those who think (that)(宾语从句) their success can be gained/achieved at the cost of rivals' failure are shortsighted . - 形式主语升级版：We can come to the conclusion that it(形式主语) is shortsighted of some people to believe that(宾语从句) they can achieve success at the expense of rivals' failure. - 词块： at the cost of = at the expense of （以……为代价）； shortsighted 目光短浅的 技巧 ：同位语从句里再嵌形式主语 it is + a. + of sb to do（品质形容词配 of），一句三层从句。 例 6 ：当我们制定目标时，我们应该考虑到是否能够完成它。 - 版本 1（宾语从句）：When we set a goal , we should consider whether we can achieve it. - 版本 2（形式主语嵌套）：When we set a goal, it is preferable that(主语从句) we (should) consider whether(宾语从句) we can achieve it. - 版本 3： It is preferable/necessary (for us) to consider whether we can achieve it. 例 7 ：看到图画中的情景，我们不禁怀疑这位父亲的行为是否能让孩子领悟"孝顺"的真正含义。 - After/When we see the scene in the picture, we can't help wondering whether(宾语从句) the father's behavior can help his children understand the true meaning of filial piety . - 词块：孝顺 filial piety （= respecting and loving parents）；不禁怀疑 can't help wondering 例 8 ：我们需要理性分析是否行业分配不公以及待遇悬殊是引起这个变化的主要原因。 - 基础版：We should analyze/analyse in a rational way whether ... are the main reasons for this change . - 形式主语版（亮点）： It is necessary for us to rationally analyze whether the unfair distribution of industries and the disparate payment are the main reasons that(定语从句) trigger/cause this change. - 词块：行业分配不公 the unfair distribution of industries ；待遇悬殊 the disparate payment / payment of distinct difference 三、主语从句基础两例 例 A ：我们所缺少的是环保意识。 - What we lack is the awareness of environmental protection .（what 从句作主语，谓语单数 is） 例 B ：他们经常把现在该做的事往后推。 - They often put off what they should do now .（what = the thing that；介词后接宾语从句；陈述语序） （五）本章总结 知识结构 ： 亮点句式·名词性从句 ├─ 语义定位：陈述事实/表达观点/提出问题 → 名词性从句（大句子套小句子） ├─ 四分类：主语从句 / 宾语从句 / 表语从句 / 同位语从句（按充当成分命名） ├─ 引导词四种结构 │ ├─ that/whether + 完整句 │ ├─ what/which/who + 非完整句（what = the thing that） │ ├─ when/where/why/how + 完整句 │ └─ how + adj./adv. + 主谓（多么……） ├─ 三条硬规则 │ ├─ 主语从句引导词不能省 │ ├─ 特殊疑问词引导 → 陈述语序 │ └─ 主语从句作主语 → 谓语单数（主谓一致） ├─ 亮点句式：形式主语 │ ├─ It is + a. + (for/of) sb to do sth. │ ├─ It is + a. + that sb (should) do sth.（建议要求类 → 虚拟 should 可省） │ └─ 品质形容词配 of sb（shortsighted of some people） └─ 升级套路 ├─ we can see that → What ... is that（主从+表从） ├─ "说" → reflect/indicate（图画句专用动词） ├─ be important → count (vi.)（Every minute counts） └─ at the cost of = at the expense of 高频考点速记 ： 考点 一句话记忆 :--- :--- 名词性从句四分类 按充当成分命名：主/宾/表/同位 what 从句 what = the thing that，从句必须缺主语或宾语 陈述语序 特殊疑问词引导从句一律陈述语序 主谓一致 主语从句作主语，谓语用单数（What we lack is ...） 引导词省略 宾语从句 that 可省，主语从句 that 不可省 形式主语模板 It is + a. + (for/of) sb to do / that sb (should) do of vs for 品质形容词（shortsighted/kind）用 of sb 虚拟语气 necessary/essential 类 + that 从句 → (should) 动词原形 图表句框架 What we can see from the table is that... 图画句动词 "说"不用 say → reflect / indicate 是否 从句中只用 whether（不用 if 更正式） 同位语从句 conclusion/problem/phenomenon/news + that + 完整句 孝顺 filial piety = respecting and loving parents 以…为代价 at the cost of = at the expense of 话题词块备份 ：market share（市场份额，shareholder 股东）、cars of national/domestic brands（国产品牌车）、dramatically/greatly（大幅度地）、the imbalance of sex/gender ratio（性别比例失衡）、take measures to maintain ecological balance（采取措施保持生态平衡）、can't help wondering（不禁怀疑）、the unfair distribution of industries（行业分配不公）、the disparate payment（待遇悬殊）、trigger/cause this change（引发变化）、put off（推迟）。

pages.title: 论述型作文-亮点句式定语从句
pages.path: 英语/写作/论述型作文-亮点句式定语从句.md
pages.text: <h2 align="center" 论述型作文·亮点句式——定语从句</h2 本讲核心 ：写作句式两大要求—— 语法正确 （基本句型 + 成分形式）与 句式结构丰富 。定语从句是"从句之首"的亮点句式：既能把零散短句合并升级，又能用 which 指代整句承载 隐含逻辑 （因果、递进）。 （一）写作句式的底层框架 一、语法正确的两块基石 1. 基本句型（5 种） 句型 结构 谓语动词 :--- :--- :--- 主谓 S + V vi. 主谓宾 S + V + O vt. 主谓双宾 S + V + O(人) + O(物) vt. 主谓宾宾补 S + V + O + C vt. 主系表 S + 系 + P be / 半系动词 2. 成分形式（三级） ：同一个成分可以由 词 → 短语 → 从句 三种形式充当，句式升级的本质就是把低级形式换成高级形式。 二、句子成分一览 主干成分（5 种） ： 成分 语义 典型词性 :--- :--- :--- 主语 谓语动作的发出者 n. 谓语 表示主语"干什么、是什么" v. 宾语 谓语动作的承受者 n. 表语 表示主语的性质/状态 n. / adj. 补语 补充说明宾语的性质状态 n. / adj. 修饰语成分（3 种） ： 成分 语义 典型词性 :--- :--- :--- 定语 修饰名词 adj. 状语 修饰 adj./v./adv. adv. 同位语 解释说明名词 n. 三、句式选择的两依据与六种语义逻辑 句式选择看两点： 语义需要 + 逻辑关系 。论述文常用的 6 种语义逻辑，各有一类句式工具与之对应： 语义逻辑 对应句式工具 :--- :--- 陈述事实 5 种基本句型（句式正确） 表达观点 名词性从句 提出问题 名词性从句 逻辑推导 状语结构（修饰、逻辑） 修饰润色 后置定语（修饰限定、解释说明） 客观存在 there be 句式 突出强调 倒装 / 强调句 （二）定语从句：语义功能与引导词 一、两大语义功能 类型 功能 标点 :--- :--- :--- 限制性定从 译作"……的"，限定先行词 无逗号 非限制性定从 解释补充说明；which 可 指代前面整个句子 逗号隔开 二、使用特征与注意点 何时想到用定从 （两个信号）： 1. 中文出现" ……的 "修饰结构 2. 修饰语中 包含动作 （如"生活在舒适环境中 的 "→ who live in ...） 两个注意 ： 1. 引导词的选择 （看先行词 + 从句缺什么成分） 2. 定语从句的 谓语与先行词保持一致 （先行词决定从句主谓的单复数） 三、引导词清单 先行词 引导词 :--- :--- sb. who / that sth. that / which sb. / sth.（所属） whose 前面整个句子 , which（非限制性） 时间 when 地点 where reason(s) why 方式 whereby 介词 + which / whom 正式书面（介词前置） 四、名词修饰语的位置总览 前置定语 （放在名词前）：a/an/the、物主代词、名词所有格、形容词、单个分词、a + 数量/种类 + of + 名词 + 后置定语 （放在名词后）：形容词短语、介词短语、不定式短语、分词短语、 定语从句 考点 ：定语从句是最长的后置定语——当修饰内容超出短语承载力（含完整动作、有自己的宾语状语）时，升级为定从。 （三）写作例题精讲（6+2 例） 一、限制性定从：修饰"……的人/物" 例 1 ：生活在舒适环境中的人们不能经受生活中的困难。 - 拆主干：人们不能经受困难（主谓宾） - 参考表达：People cannot withstand / weather difficulty / hardship.（板书补充：face / cope with） - 定从升级：People who live in a comfortable / cozy environment cannot withstand difficulties in life. 技巧 ：先写主干，再把"……的"修饰部分用定从挂到名词上。 例 2 ：俗话说：世上无难事，只怕有心人。 - 固定句式： As the saying goes , ... - 拆译：世上没有困难的事 → There is nothing difficult in the world. = Nothing in the world is difficult. - "有心人"三连：who has determination = who is determined = who sets his mind (to do it) - 参考：As the saying goes, nothing in the world is difficult for one who sets his mind to do it . 二、并列句 → 定语从句的升级 例 3 ：独立带来很多好处，其中最重要的是自我决定（self-determination）。 - 并列句版：Independence brings / leads to many / various advantages, and the most important one is self-determination. - 定从版（亮点）：Independence brings / leads to many / various advantages, the most important of which is self-determination. 技巧 ："...，其中最……" → the + 最高级 + of which ，比 and 接并列分句高一个档次。 三、非限制性 which 指代整句 例 4 ：图片表明，一个国家的文化可能会成为国际的文化，这有利于所有的人类。 - 陈述句版：The picture indicates / shows that ... - as 从句版： As the picture indicates , ...（as 也可指代整句，放句首） - 参考：A kind of national culture may become an international one, which benefits all the humans . - 要点：①非限制性定从 ②引导词指代 前面的整个句子 （"这有利于"的"这"） 例 5 ：普遍存在的虚假广告破坏了企业和顾客之间的信任，长此以往，这最终将阻碍我们国家的经济迅速发展。 - 词块：普遍存在的 common / widespread（板书补充 fake / misleading）；虚假广告 false and deceptive advertisement / advertising；破坏 destroy；阻碍 hinder - 参考：The widespread false and deceptive advertising destroys the trust between enterprises and customers / consumers , which in the long run will hinder the rapid economic development of our country . - 要点： which in the long run will... —— 用一个 which 从句同时装下"长此以往 + 阻碍发展"两层信息。 例 6 ：和谐的邻里关系是必要的，因为这能够让人们日常生活的环境更平和。 - 词块：和谐的 harmonious（harmony n.）；邻里关系 harmonious neighborhood（= the relationship between neighbors）；必要的 necessary / essential； be of necessity = is necessary（介词短语表性质，主系表的高级形式） - 参考：Harmonious neighborhood relation is of necessity , which can make people's common living environment more peaceful . - 要点： 定语从句承载语义隐含逻辑（如因果） ——中文用"因为"明示，英文用 which 从句隐含。 四、介词 + which/whom 例 7 ：我们盼望已久的机会终于到来了。 - 基础版：The opportunity / chance has finally come.（期盼 expect / long for） - 定从版：The opportunity which / that we have been longing for has finally come. - 介词前置版（亮点）：= The opportunity for which we have been longing has finally come. 技巧 ：短语动词里的介词（long for ）可提到 which 前 → for which ，书面感立刻拉满。 例 8 ：图中描绘了两位残疾人，只有一条腿。 - ✗ The picture depicts two handicapped men, who have only one leg .（两人共用一条腿？语义错位） - ✓ The picture depicts two handicapped men, each of whom has only one leg .（"各自"一条腿 → each of whom；谓语随之用单数 has） 易错点 ："每者/各自"类语义用 each of whom / each of which ；引导词作从句主语时谓语数随 each 变单数。 （四）本章总结 知识结构 ： 亮点句式·定语从句 ├─ 底层框架 │ ├─ 语法正确 = 基本句型(5种) + 成分形式(词/短语/从句) │ ├─ 主干 5 成分(主谓宾表补) + 修饰语 3 成分(定状同位) │ └─ 句式选择 = 语义需要 + 逻辑关系 → 6 种语义逻辑各配一类句式 ├─ 定语从句本体 │ ├─ 语义功能：限制性("的") / 非限制性(补充说明, which 指代整句) │ ├─ 使用信号："……的" + 修饰语含动作 │ ├─ 引导词清单：who/that·which/whose/when/where/why/whereby/介词+which(whom) │ └─ 两个注意：引导词选择；从句谓语与先行词一致 ├─ 写作升级套路 │ ├─ 并列句 → 定从：..., and the most important one → the most important of which │ ├─ 因果隐含："因为这" → , which can make... │ ├─ 整句指代："这/长此以往" → , which (in the long run) will... │ ├─ 介词前置：longing for → for which │ └─ 各自语义：各自一条腿 → each of whom has... └─ 话题词块：withstand/weather hardship、false and deceptive advertising、 harmonious neighborhood、be of necessity、self-determination、in the long run hinder 高频考点速记 ： 考点 一句话记忆 :--- :--- 何时用定从 中文带"……的"且修饰语含动作 限制性 vs 非限制性 有限定译"的"；带逗号作补充说明 which 指代 非限制性 which 可指代前面整句（"这"） as 与 which As the picture indicates 放句首；which 从句放句尾 "其中最…" the + 最高级 + of which（替代 and 并列句） 介词+which 短语动词介词可前置：long for → for which each of whom "各自"用 each of whom，谓语单数 从句主谓一致 从句谓语的数由先行词决定 高级表语 is necessary → is of necessity 经历困难 withstand / weather / face / cope with hardship 虚假广告 false and deceptive advertising；普遍的 widespread 谚语引入 As the saying goes, ... 话题词块备份 ：self-determination（自我决定）、harmonious neighborhood（和谐邻里）、economic boom 的反衬 hinder the rapid economic development（阻碍经济迅速发展）、in the long run（长此以往）。

pages.title: 论述型作文-亮点句式特殊结构
pages.path: 英语/写作/论述型作文-亮点句式特殊结构.md
pages.text: <h2 align="center" 论述型作文·亮点句式——特殊结构</h2 本讲核心 ：特殊结构 = 倒装结构 （完全倒装 / 部分倒装）+ 强调句 。两大用途：① 完全倒装 用于首段引出主题、平衡句子结构；② 部分倒装与强调句式 用于"强调"。贯穿全讲的一条硬规矩： 主谓一致 。 （一）特殊结构总览 结构树 ： 特殊结构 ├─ 倒装结构 │ ├─ 完全倒装 —— 平衡句子结构 / 引出主题（首段用） │ └─ 部分倒装 —— 用于"强调" └─ 强调句 —— It is + 强调内容 + that + 句子其它成分 两条主线与注意点 ： 1. 表强调 ：部分倒装 / 强调句式——注意 ① 句式 （倒装形式、that 后接完整句）② 主谓一致 2. 平衡句子结构 / 引出主题 ：完全倒装——注意 主谓一致 （二）完全倒装：引出主题与平衡结构 一、结构与判定 完全倒装 = 介词短语 / 分词短语 / 形容词短语 + 谓语 + 主语（+ 后置定语） - 与"部分倒装"的区别：完全倒装是 整个谓语 提到主语之前（不是只提前助动词） - 课件亦称"完整倒装" - ⚠️ 注意主谓一致性 ——主语在谓语之后，动词的单复数要跟着 真正的主语 走 二、用途一：引出图画 / 图表主体内容（首段专用） 句式模板 ： 1. Depicted / Shown / Presented in the picture / chart is / are + 句子主语（主体对象） - 把"图片中描绘的是……"从平淡的主谓句，升级为 分词短语开头的完全倒装 例 1 ：图片中描述的是一位面带微笑并身着中国传统服饰的美国姑娘。 - 基本句型：主谓宾 - 原句：An American girl with smile and in Chinese traditional costumes is depicted in the picture. - 完全倒装： Depicted in the picture is an American girl with smile and in Chinese traditional costumes. - 另一路（主系表 + 主语从句）： What the picture depicts is an American girl with smile and in Chinese traditional costumes. - 词块：中国传统服饰 Chinese traditional costumes 例 2 ：如图所绘，一个打翻了的瓶子面前站着两个人，瓶子里大部分的水正在往外流。 - 分词短语倒装： Depicted in the picture are two men standing in front of a turned-over bottle , with most of the water flowing out from the bottle .（后半句是 伴随结构 ） - 介词短语倒装（更简洁）： In front of a bottle stand two men. - 加"As is depicted"引入： As is depicted, in front of a turned-over bottle stand two men. - 词块：打翻的瓶子 a turned-over bottle；流出 flow out - 要点：主语 two men 是复数 → 谓语用 are / stand （主谓一致） 例 3 ：图中展示出来的是一个引人注目的场景，一群毕业生正站在通向未来的重要转折点。 - Depicted in the picture is an eye-catching scene : a group / crop of undergraduates are standing at a critical point (leading) to the future . - 词块：引人注目的场景 an eye-catching scene；毕业生 / 本科生 undergraduates；关键转折点 a critical point - 要点：冒号后可另起一句补充说明画面细节 三、用途二：平衡句子结构 主语过长、修饰语过多时，用完全倒装把长修饰语提到句首，让 主语后置 ——句子结构立刻平衡。 （三）部分倒装：Only + 状语（强调） 一、触发条件 only + 状语（介词短语 / 状语从句）位于句首 → 主句用部分倒装 （只提前助动词 / 情态动词 / be； 从句本身不倒装 ）。 - 中文"只有……才……"的固定对应结构 - 语义逻辑关系： 条件—结果 或 方式—目的 二、两种常见形式 形式 ①：Only + 介词短语 （方式—目的） - Only by pursuing persistent self-improvement can one be ever-victorious in the society. - Only in this way can we achieve success. 形式 ②：Only + 状语从句 （条件—结果） - Only if a man pursues self-improvement persistently can he be a constant winner in the society. 三、写作例题 例 1 ：只有一直追求自我进步，一个人才能成为社会上的常胜将军。 - 语义逻辑：条件和结果 / 方式和目的 - 基础版（条件句）：If a man pursues self-improvement persistently, he or she can be a constant winner in the society. - 基础版（方式）：By pursuing persistent self-improvement, one can be ever-victorious in the society. - 倒装版（亮点） ： - Only if a man pursues self-improvement persistently can he be a constant winner in the society. （only + 状语从句，主句倒装） - = Only by pursuing persistent self-improvement can one be ever-victorious in the society. （only + 介词短语） - 词块：自我进步 self-improvement；一直、持久地 persistently；常胜将军 a constant winner；不断获胜的 ever-victorious 例 2 ：只有建立一个更有效利用能源的社会，才有可能永久地保持我们现代化的生活。 - 语义逻辑：条件—结果 // 方式—目的 - 参考： Only if we build a society where energy can be effectively used can our modern life be sustained. - 词块：可持续的 sustainable；能源 energy；有效地 effectively - 要点：society 后接 where 定语从句，主句再用倒装 can our modern life be sustained 例 3 ：只有这样我们才能取得成功，我们的社会才能更加和谐。 - 参考： Only in this way can we achieve success and can our society be more harmonious. - 要点：两个并列分句 都要倒装 （can we ... and can our society ...）；和谐的 harmonious 易错点 ：only 修饰 主语 时不倒装（Only he knows the truth.）；只有 only + 状语 提前才倒装。 易错点 ： only if / only when 引导的 从句用陈述语序 ，倒装发生在 主句 。 （四）强调句式：It is + 强调内容 + that 一、结构 It is + 强调内容 + that + 句子其它成分 - 把句中想突出的成分（主语 / 宾语 / 状语）移到 It is ... that 之间 - that 之后是 句子的其余成分 （拼回去仍是完整句）——注意 主谓一致 不变 二、写作例题 例 1 ：只有这样我们才能取得成功。（强调内容： 方式状语 ） - 原句：We can achieve success in this way. - 强调： It is in this way that we can achieve success. 例 2 ：成功人士最突出的品质是自信、欲望，还有决心。（强调 主语 ） - 基本句型：主系表 - 原句：The most outstanding qualities for successful men are confidence, aspiration and determination. - = Confidence, aspiration and determination are the most outstanding qualities for successful men. - 强调： It is confidence, aspiration and determination that are the most outstanding qualities for successful men. - 词块：突出品质 outstanding qualities；自信 confidence；欲望、抱负 aspiration；决心 determination - 要点：强调主语时，that 后的谓语与原主语一致（→ are ） 例 3 ：正是父母赋予了我们生命而且费尽苦心养育我们成长。（强调 主语 ） - 句子主干：父母赋予了我们生命而且费尽苦心养育我们成长。 - 参考： It is our parents that not only gave life to us but also have done so much in raising us up. - 词块：赋予生命 give life to sb；养育 raise sb up；费尽苦心地 painstakingly - 要点：强调句式里可嵌 not only ... but also 并列谓语 例 4 ：不断学习能激发我们追求更好的生活和更光明的未来。（强调 主语 ） - 基本句型：主谓宾 + 宾补 - 激发某人做某事： inspire / stimulate / motivate / promote sb to do sth. - 不断学习：constant / persistent learning - 参考： It is constant learning that inspires us to pursue better life and brighter future. - 要点：强调主语 constant learning（单数）→ 谓语用 inspires 考点 ：强调句的判定与还原——去掉 It is ... that 后句子仍完整，即为强调句（与主语从句区分）。 注意 ：主谓一致——强调主语时，that 后谓语随 被强调的主语 变化（determination... are / constant learning inspires）。 （五）本章总结 知识结构 ： 亮点句式·特殊结构 ├─ 倒装结构 │ ├─ 完全倒装（介词/分词/形容词短语 + 谓语 + 主语；注意主谓一致） │ │ ├─ 用途一：引出图画/图表主体 —— 首段专用 │ │ │ └─ Depicted / Shown / Presented in the picture / chart is / are + 主语 │ │ │ （例1 美国姑娘 / 例2 打翻的瓶子 / 例3 毕业生转折点） │ │ └─ 用途二：平衡句子结构（长主语后置） │ └─ 部分倒装（only + 状语位于句首 → 主句倒装） │ ├─ Only + 介词短语：Only by doing ..., can one ... │ └─ Only + 状语从句：Only if ..., can he ... │ （例1 自我进步 / 例2 能源社会 / 例3 取得成功与和谐社会） └─ 强调句：It is + 强调内容 + that + 句子其它成分 ├─ 强调状语：It is in this way that we can achieve success. ├─ 强调主语：It is confidence, aspiration and determination that are ... ├─ 强调主语 + 并列：It is our parents that not only gave life to us but also ... └─ 强调主语 + 宾补结构：It is constant learning that inspires us to ... 高频考点速记 ： 考点 一句话记忆 :--- :--- 完全倒装公式 介词/分词/形容词短语 + 谓语 + 主语（+ 后置定语） 完全倒装用途 ① 首段引出图画/图表主体 ② 平衡句子结构 图表句模板 Depicted / Shown / Presented in the picture is / are + 主体 主谓一致（倒装） 谓语随 真正的主语 变化（two men → are / stand） 部分倒装触发 only + 状语 （介词短语 / 状语从句）置于句首 only + 介短 Only by pursuing ... can one ... only + 状从 Only if ... can he ...（从句不倒装，主句倒装） 倒装例外 only 修饰 主语 时不倒装 强调句公式 It is + 强调内容 + that + 句子其它成分 强调句判定 去掉 It is ... that 后句子仍完整 可强调成分 主语 / 宾语 / 状语（方式状语最常见） 强调句主谓一致 that 后谓语随被强调的主语变化 如图所绘 As is depicted, ... / Depicted in the picture ... 激发某人做某事 inspire / stimulate / motivate / promote sb to do sth. 常胜将军 a constant winner；ever-victorious 可持续的 sustainable；有效的 effectively 突出品质 outstanding qualities（自信 confidence / 抱负 aspiration / 决心 determination） 话题词块备份 ：be depicted in the picture（被描绘于图中）、Chinese traditional costumes（中国传统服饰）、a turned-over bottle（打翻的瓶子）、flow out（流出）、an eye-catching scene（引人注目的场景）、undergraduates（毕业生 / 本科生）、a critical point（关键转折点）、self-improvement（自我进步）、persistently（持久地）、harmonious（和谐的）、give life to sb（赋予生命）、raise sb up（养育）、painstakingly（费尽苦心地）、constant / persistent learning（不断学习）、pursue better life and brighter future（追求更好的生活与更光明的未来）。

pages.title: 论述型作文-亮点句式状语从句
pages.path: 英语/写作/论述型作文-亮点句式状语从句.md
pages.text: <h2 align="center" 论述型作文·亮点句式——状语从句</h2 本讲核心 ：状语从句 = 引导词 + 句子 ，句法功能是 修饰动作/句子 。写作时的不变式： 先判断句内语义逻辑，再据逻辑选引导词 ——逻辑决定从句类型，引导词只是逻辑的标签。 （一）状语从句的定位与构成 构成 ：引导词 + 句子（引导词本身就是逻辑关系的标记，一听就知道主从句之间是什么关系）。 两条线索 ： 维度 内容 :--- :--- 句法功能 修饰 动作或整个句子 语义逻辑 时间、地点、方式、原因、结果、条件、让步（+ 对比、伴随） （二）写作常用六大状语类型（引导词总表） 类型 常用引导词 要点 :--- :--- :--- 时间 when / while / since（自从）/ as（随着）/ before / after 注意主从句的时态 条件 if 主将从现 （主句将来时，从句用现在时） 原因 because 因果链最直接的表达 结果 / 目的 so that 同形不同义：看从句是"目的"还是"结果" 让步 although / though 主句前不能再用 but 对比 while 两事并列对照 考点 ： so that 双身份——表 目的 （"以便"）时从句常带 can/could；表 结果 （"以至于"）时直接陈述既成事实。 易错点 ：if 条件句"主将从现"——If we get fully prepared（不是 will get）, we can embrace ... （三）写作例题精讲（8 例） 一、while：伴随 / 对比 例 1 ：一个球员正准备射门，而守门员正全力准备回击这次攻击。 - 句内逻辑： 伴随 或 对比 ；逻辑词 while - 前置版： While a player is about to shoot the ball , the goalkeeper is ready to defend . - 后置版：A player is about to shoot the ball, while the goalkeeper is ready to defend. - 词块： be about to do 正要做； shoot the ball 射门； defend 防守、回击 技巧 ：中文"而"表对照 → 一律先想 while ；从句在前更书面，在后更流畅。 例 2 ：球员认为这项任务非常艰巨，因为球门如此之小而守门员长得高大威猛；守门员却害怕球门太大而自己太渺小，很难护住球门。 - 英文框架：The player ..., while（表对比） the goalkeeper ... - 组合表达：The player sees the task tough because the goal is much smaller compared with the giant goalkeeper, while the goalkeeper feels himself so smaller than the goal that he can not defend the goal. - 词块： tough 艰巨的； compared with 与……相比； giant 作名词 = 巨人，作形容词 = 巨大的 技巧 ：一句里叠三层逻辑——because（原因）+ while（对比）+ so...that（结果），这是"两个主体各说一句"的高级写法。 二、because：原因 例 3 ：他们做这些是因为他们崇拜明星，并想获得明星那样的声望和影响。 - 英文框架：They do this because ... - 从句内并列：because they worship stars and desire to gain the same fame and influence like theirs - 词块： worship 崇拜； fame / reputation 声望； influence 影响； desire to do 想要/打算做某事 技巧 ：because 从句里用 and 接并列谓语（崇拜 + 想获得），一个原因说两层内容。 例 4 ：研究发现，积极的态度有益于生活，因为它会帮助我们解决棘手问题。 - 基础版（because 明示因果）：A positive attitude / mind is beneficial to life, because it will help us solve tough problems. - 升级版（which 隐含因果）：A positive attitude / mind is beneficial to life, which（定语从句） will help us solve tough problems. - 词块： be beneficial to 有益于； solve tough problems 解决棘手问题 "研究发现"三框架 ： 序号 句式 从句类型 :--- :--- :--- ① Researches have found that ... 宾语从句 ② As researches have found , ... 定语从句（as 指代整句） ③ It has been found by researches that ... 形式主语 + 主语从句 技巧 ："因为这"不一定写 because——用 , which will ... 让因果隐入定语从句，句式立刻升级（详见《定语从句》）。 三、so that：结果 / 目的 例 5 ：大多数孩子课业太重，都无暇参加社会活动。（语义逻辑： 因果关系 ） - （1） Because most children are having too much school work, they have no time to participate in social activities.（原因状从） - （2）Most children are having too much school work so that they have no time to participate in social activities.（so that 表 结果 ） - （3）Most children are having so much school work that they have no time to participate in social activities.（ so...that 如此……以至于） - 词块： too much school work 课业太重； so much ... that 如此多以至于； have no time to do 无暇； participate in 参加 考点 ：同一语义三种句式 → 因果状从（because）、结果状从（so that）、结果状从强化（so...that）。改卷老师最认 (3) 的 so...that 结构。 例 6 ：我们应扩大在社区和学校的宣传，以便让人们意识到保护环境的重要性和迫切性。 - 目的状语： so that + 句子 ； in order to do sth. - 词块： 扩大宣传 expand / increase advertising / promotion ； 社区 communities ； as well as 以及； bring sb into realization of 让某人意识到； urgency 迫切性 - 参考：It is necessary to expand advertising in communities as well as schools so that we can bring people into realization of the importance and urgency of protecting the environment. 技巧 ："以便/从而" → so that ；主句用 It is necessary to do 形式主语，避免"we should"开头的老套。 四、if：条件 例 7 ：如果我们准备充分，我们就能迎接未来的挑战并成为新时代的赢家。 - 条件状从： if + 句子 - 词块： 准备充分 be fully prepared / be ready ； 迎接挑战 embrace / meet the future challenges ； winner 赢家； new era 新时代 - 参考： If we get fully prepared , we can embrace the future challenges and become winners in the new era . - 要点：主将从现—— If we get （现在时）..., we can embrace ... 例 8 ：如果你可以很好地平衡这种关系，你肯定能获得足够的知识同时还获得经验，从而为将来的成功做好准备。 - 词块："获得"升级链 get / gain / obtain / acquire / achieve - acquire / accumulate knowledge 获得、积累知识 - gain experience 获得经验 - be prepared for 为……做好准备 - 参考： If you can balance this relationship well , you will definitely acquire enough knowledge and gain experience so that you can be prepared for the future success. - 要点：if（条件）+ so that（结果）首尾呼应； definitely 加强语气 （四）本章总结 知识结构 ： 亮点句式·状语从句 ├─ 构成：引导词 + 句子；先定语义逻辑，再选引导词 ├─ 句法功能：修饰动作 / 整个句子 ├─ 六大写作状语类型（引导词表） │ ├─ 时间 when/while/since/as(随着)/before/after —— 注意主从句时态 │ ├─ 条件 if —— 主将从现 │ ├─ 原因 because │ ├─ 结果/目的 so that（看从句性质定目的还是结果） │ ├─ 让步 although/though（不再接 but） │ └─ 对比 while（"而"） ├─ 高频升级套路 │ ├─ "而" → while（伴随/对比） │ ├─ "因为这" → , which will ...（转定语从句，隐含因果） │ ├─ "研究发现" → ①that 宾从 ②As... ③It has been found that 主从 │ ├─ 因果三写 → because / so that / so...that │ ├─ 目的 → so that + 句子、in order to do │ └─ 多层叠加 → because + while + so...that └─ 词块：be about to do、compared with、be beneficial to、 expand/increase advertising、bring sb into realization of、 be fully prepared、embrace challenges、acquire knowledge / gain experience 高频考点速记 ： 考点 一句话记忆 :--- :--- 状语从句构成 引导词 + 句子，选词看语义逻辑 时间状从 when/while/since/as(随着)/before/after，盯主从句时态 条件状从 if，主将从现 让步 although/though 不与 but 连用 对比 中文"而" → while so that 双面 目的"以便"；结果"以至于" 结果强化 so + adj./adv. + that（如此……以至于） 因果三写 because / so that / so...that，同义轮换 "因为这"升级 , which will ...（定语从句隐含因果） 研究发现 that 宾从 / As researches have found / It has been found that 目的表达 so that + 句子；in order to do sth. 射门 shoot the ball；be about to do 正要做 与…相比 compared with；giant 名/形同形 获得（分对象） acquire/accumulate knowledge；gain experience 迎接挑战 embrace / meet the challenges 扩大宣传 expand / increase advertising / promotion 让人意识到 bring sb into realization of 准备充分 be fully prepared；be prepared for 话题词块备份 ：defend（防守）、tough（艰巨的）、worship stars（崇拜明星）、fame/reputation（声望）、be beneficial to（有益于）、participate in social activities（参加社会活动）、urgency（迫切性）、new era（新时代）、balance the relationship（平衡关系）、definitely（肯定、无疑）。

pages.title: 论述型作文-亮点句式非谓语动词
pages.path: 英语/写作/论述型作文-亮点句式非谓语动词.md
pages.text: <h2 align="center" 论述型作文·亮点句式——非谓语动词</h2 本讲核心 ：一句话 只有一个谓语 ；第二个动词必须降级为 非谓语 （动名词 / 不定式 / 分词）。写作中非谓语承担三件事：① 动名词、不定式 = sth.（作主语、宾语，可升级为 形式主语句式 ）② 不定式、分词作 定语 ③ 分词作 状语 （承载 隐性逻辑关系 ）。 （一）非谓语动词总览 一、为什么需要非谓语 1. 谓语只有 1 个 ：动词作谓语，一句话只有一个；若需要 ≥2 个谓语动词，必须 加连词 （and / but / because ...） 2. 非谓语 ：不作谓语的动词形式——让句子在"不另起从句"的前提下多装动作，是句式升级的常规手段 二、三类非谓语：性质与句法功能 非谓语 形式 性质 句法功能 :--- :--- :--- :--- 动名词 v-ing 名词 主语 / 宾语 / 定语 / 表语 不定式 to + v. 名词 / 形容词 / 副词 主语 / 宾语 / 表语 / 宾补 / 定语 / 状语 分词 现在分词 v-ing<br 过去分词 v-ed 形容词 / 副词 定语 / 状语 / 宾补 / 表语 记忆 ：动名词 = 名词（"做某事"这件事）；不定式 = 多面手（名 / 形 / 副）；分词 = 形容词副词（ 主动用 -ing，被动用 -ed ）。 三、写作中的三条用法（本讲小结） 1. 动名词 / 不定式 == sth. ——当名词用（作主语、宾语）； 特殊句式：形式主语句式 2. 不定式 / 分词作定语 ——挂到名词前后 3. 分词作状语 ——修饰整个句子，承载 隐性逻辑关系 （原因、结果、伴随等） （二）用法一：动名词 / 不定式 = sth.（作主语、宾语） 一、作主语："做某事是 / 意味着……" 1. Blackmailing and cheating tourists will surely destroy the reputation of the tourist attractions.（勒索游客这件事） - 词块：勒索 blackmail；欺诈 cheat；名誉 reputation；旅游景点 tourist attractions 2. Ensuring the continuous prosperity of Chinese traditional drama means making great contribution to the conservation of the world culture.（A means B 主谓宾） - 词块：确保 ensure sth. / ensure that sth. happens；持续繁荣 continuous prosperity（活力 vitality）；保存、保护 conserve / preserve；保护（名词）conservation 3. Finding the reason for the new phenomenon which involves some complicated factors is no easy task .（主语很长 → 直接升级形式主语） - 词块：复杂因素 complicated factors；绝非易事 no easy task 考点 ：动名词作主语，谓语用 单数 ——Ensuring ... means ...；Finding ... is ...。 技巧 ：主语一长，立刻改 形式主语句式 （下节）——"长主语后置"既平衡结构又提分。 二、形式主语句式（特殊亮点句式） 两条用途 ： 1. 表达建议 / 要求 ："应该 / 必须" 2. 平衡句子结构 ： 长主语后置 两个模板 ： 模板 ①：It is + a. + (for sb) + to do sth. （不定式短语后置） 1. It is not difficult (for us) to find that students who have a positive mind usually get good scores in exams.（不难发现……） - 同义升级：be outstanding among peers（在同伴中出类拔萃）；excel in sth.（擅长某事） 2. It is necessary (for us) to reasonably use the Internet and take immediate measures to eliminate its negative impact. - 词块：合理地使用网络 reasonably use the Internet；立即采取措施 take immediate measures；消除负面影响 eliminate its negative impact 3. It is not / by no means easy to find the reason for the new phenomenon which involves some complicated factors.（by no means = 绝不） 模板 ②：It is + a. / v-ed + that + 句子 （主语从句后置） 可替换的形容词库 ：a must / necessary / essential / important / imperative（必须的）/ suggested / advised / preferable 特别推荐 ： It is a must to do sth. （必须做某事）——"必须"的高级表达 4. Considering the severity of the problem / issue, it is a must to take effective measures before the deterioration of the situation. - 词块：考虑到 Considering / Given sth.；严重性 severity；恶化 deteriorate / go from bad to worse / get worse；恶化（名词）deterioration；有效措施 effective measures 易错点 ：表人品质的形容词（kind / shortsighted / wise）用 of sb ；一般形容词（necessary / difficult / important）用 for sb 。 技巧 ：中文"我们必须……"→ It is a must / necessary (for us) to ...，比 We must ... 高级一档。 （三）用法二：不定式 / 分词作定语 1. 不定式作定语 （后置）：the reason to do sth.；the opportunity to succeed 2. 分词作定语 ： 前置 / 后置 均可； 主动用现在分词（-ing），被动用过去分词（-ed） - There are many cultural elements / ingredients being boiled in the hot pot .（火锅中有很多 被煮的 文化元素） - 要点：被动的"正在被……"用 现在分词的被动式 being done ；单纯被动用过去分词 done 判据一句话 ：名词与分词是 主动关系 → -ing；是 被动关系 → -ed。 （四）用法三：分词作状语（隐性逻辑关系） 分词作状语是最"亮"的一档：中文用"因为 / 于是 / 同时"明说，英文可以用分词 隐含 。 一、同一主体 → 普通分词状语（现在分词表主动） 1. 表伴随 ：The athlete finally reaches the finishing line, sweating but smiling . - 同义版：= The athlete finally reaches the finishing line with sweat and smiles on his face . - 词块：运动员 athlete；终点线 finishing line；汗 sweat 2. 表结果 ：Some children are spoiled by their parents, having no opportunity to understand what the hardship is . - 词块：宠坏 spoil；苦难 hardship 3. 表原因（前置） ： Spoiled by their parents , some children have no opportunity to understand what the hardship is. - 要点：同一句话可"前置表原因、后置表结果"，靠分词位置切换逻辑重心 二、不同主体 → 分词独立主格结构（表伴随） 1. Two tourists are chatting and eating on a boat, throwing much rubbish / garbage / waste into the lake .（分词逻辑主语 = 主句主语，普通分词状语） 2. = Two tourists are chatting and eating on a boat, (with) much rubbish thrown into the lake .（分词逻辑主语 = much rubbish ≠ 主句主语 → 独立主格 ，可加 with） - 词块：垃圾 rubbish / garbage / waste；扔 throw 考点 ： 现在分词表主动，过去分词表被动 ；分词逻辑主语与主句主语 一致 → 普通状语， 不一致 → 独立主格（(with) + 名词 + 分词）。 技巧 ：中文"一边……一边……""……，把……"最适合用分词伴随，一句装两个动作。 （五）例题精讲 一、非谓语作主语 / 定语 / 状语（例 1～例 9） 例 1 ：对游客进行经济勒索肯定会损坏旅游景点的名誉。 - 基本句型：主谓宾；"勒索"作主语 → 动名词 - 参考： Blackmailing and cheating tourists will surely destroy the reputation of the tourist attractions. - 词块：勒索 blackmail；欺诈 cheat；名誉 reputation；景点 scenic spots / places of interest / tourist attractions 例 2 ：确保中国传统戏剧的持续繁荣意味着为世界文化保存做出巨大贡献。 - 基本句型：主谓宾（A means B）；"确保……"作主语 → 动名词 - 参考： Ensuring the continuous prosperity of Chinese traditional drama means making great contribution to the conservation of the world culture. - 词块：持续繁荣 continuous prosperity / vitality；保存 conserve / preserve；贡献 make contribution to 例 4 ：汗如雨下，面带微笑，这位运动员终于到达了终点线。 - 句式特点： 同一主体，同时发出多个动作 → 分词表伴随（现在分词表主动） - 参考：The athlete finally reaches the finishing line, sweating but smiling . - 同义版：= The athlete finally reaches the finishing line with sweat and smiles on his face. 例 5 ：两名游客在船上边吃边聊，许多垃圾被扔到了湖里。 （= 两名游客在船上边吃边聊，把许多垃圾扔到了湖里。） - 组合表达（同一主体，主动）：Two tourists are chatting and eating on a boat, throwing much rubbish into the lake . - 独立主格（不同主体，被动）：= Two tourists are chatting and eating on a boat, (with) much rubbish thrown into the lake . - 要点： 分词独立主格结构表伴随——用于主从句主体不同时 例 3 ：这个新出现的现象涉及一些复杂的因素，找到其原因绝非易事。 - 组合句（动名词作主语）： Finding the reason for the new phenomenon which involves some complicated factors is no easy task . - 升级形式主语：→ It is not / by no means easy to find the reason for the new phenomenon which involves some complicated factors. - 要点：长主语后置，同时把"绝非易事"写成 not / by no means easy 例 6 ：火锅中有很多被煮的文化元素。 - 句型：there be + 分词作定语 - 参考：There are many cultural elements / ingredients being boiled in the hot pot . - 要点：分词作定语 前置 / 后置 皆可； 主动-现在分词，被动-过去分词 （"被煮的"→ being boiled） 例 7 ：孩子被父母宠坏了，从来没有机会了解苦难是什么。 - 逻辑： 原因 + 结果 ；句子主体：孩子 - 结果版（分词后置表结果）：Some children are spoiled by their parents, having no opportunity to understand what the hardship is . - 原因版（分词前置表原因）：= Spoiled by their parents , some children have no opportunity to understand what the hardship is. - 词块：宠坏 spoil；苦难 hardship 例 9 ：考虑到问题的严重性，在事态进一步恶化之前必须采取有效措施。 - 词块：考虑到 Considering / Given sth.；必须 It is a must to do sth.；恶化 deteriorate / go from bad to worse / get worse - 参考： Considering the severity of the problem / issue, it is a must to take effective measures before the deterioration of the situation. - 要点：分词 Considering 作状语（隐性原因）+ 形式主语 it is a must to do 二、形式主语句式专项（改写演示） 例 1 ：我们有必要合理地使用网络并且立即采取有效措施消除它的负面影响。 - 参考： It is necessary (for us) to reasonably use the Internet and take immediate measures to eliminate its negative impact . - 要点：中文"我们有必要……"→ It is necessary for us to ...（长主语、语气客观） 例 2 ：不难发现心态积极的学生通常都在考试中取得好成绩。 - 参考： It is not difficult (for us) to find that students who have a positive mind usually get good scores in exams. - 升级词块：be outstanding among peers（在同伴中出类拔萃）；excel in sth.（擅长某事） - 要点：形式主语 + that 宾语从句 + who 定语从句 三层叠加 （六）本章总结 知识结构 ： 亮点句式·非谓语动词 ├─ 为什么：一句话只有一个谓语；≥2 个谓语要加连词 ├─ 三类非谓语 │ ├─ 动名词 v-ing（名词性）：主语/宾语/定语/表语 │ ├─ 不定式 to+v.（名/形/副）：主语/宾语/表语/宾补/定语/状语 │ └─ 分词 v-ing / v-ed（形/副）：定语/状语/宾补/表语 ├─ 三条写作用法 │ ├─ ① 动名词/不定式 == sth.（作主语宾语） │ │ └─ 特殊句式：形式主语句式 │ │ ├─ It is + a. + (for/of) sb + to do（不定式后置） │ │ ├─ It is + a./v-ed + that + 句子（主语从句后置） │ │ └─ 词库：a must / necessary / essential / important / imperative / suggested / advised / preferable │ ├─ ② 不定式/分词作定语（主动 -ing，被动 -ed；前置/后置） │ └─ ③ 分词作状语（隐性逻辑：原因/结果/伴随） │ ├─ 同一主体 → 普通分词状语 │ └─ 不同主体 → 分词独立主格 (with) + n. + 分词 └─ 词块：blackmail/cheat、continuous prosperity、conserve/preserve、 no easy task、by no means、spoil、deteriorate、severity、 effective measures、eliminate negative impact、excel in sth. 高频考点速记 ： 考点 一句话记忆 :--- :--- 非谓语的三类 动名词（名词）、不定式（名形副）、分词（形副） 主动 vs 被动 分词表主动用 -ing，表被动用 -ed 动名词作主语 谓语用单数（Ensuring ... means ...） 长主语处理 长主语后置 → 形式主语句式 形式主语两模板 It is + a. + (for/of) sb to do；It is + a./v-ed + that + 句子 of vs for 表人品质的形容词用 of sb，其余用 for sb "必须"升级 It is a must to do sth. 形式主语词库 a must / necessary / essential / important / imperative / suggested / advised / preferable 分词作定语 前置/后置均可；"被……的"用过去分词或 being done 分词作状语 承载隐性逻辑：前置多表原因，后置多表结果/伴随 独立主格 逻辑主语 ≠ 主句主语 → (with) + 名词 + 分词 伴随表达 ..., sweating but smiling / throwing ... into the lake 考虑到的分词 Considering / Given sth. 恶化 deteriorate / go from bad to worse / get worse；名词 deterioration 绝非易事 no easy task；by no means easy 出类拔萃 be outstanding among peers；excel in sth. 话题词块备份 ：blackmail（勒索）、cheat（欺诈）、reputation（名誉）、tourist attractions / scenic spots / places of interest（景点）、continuous prosperity / vitality（持续繁荣）、conserve / preserve / conservation（保存保护）、complicated factors（复杂因素）、spoil（宠坏）、hardship（苦难）、rubbish / garbage / waste（垃圾）、severity（严重性）、effective measures（有效措施）、eliminate its negative impact（消除负面影响）。

pages.text: <h2 align="center" 论述型作文·冲刺备考手册（15 页版）</h2 用法 ：全篇 15 节 ＝ 15 页 ，每节末尾有分页符（Typora 导出 PDF 即一节一页）。 第 3～8 页是"按段落位置"的模板，第 9～11 页是"按功能"的扩展句式，第 13～15 页是五篇范文 ——句式后的例句尽量直接引自范文，并标注出处（如"范文二 ④"＝第 2 篇范文第 4 句），背句式时对着范文一起背。 来源 ：由 论述型作文-图画作文首段.md、论述型作文-主体段与结论段.md、论述型作文-图画作文速成.md、论述型作文-图表作文速成.md、论述型作文-三段写作模板.md、写作句式.md、写作素材.md 压缩而成。 第 1 页 · 三段骨架与时间分配 三段时间 ：审题立意 2 分钟 → 编列提纲 3 分钟 → 布局 + 成文 30 分钟 。框架提前背熟，考场只做三件事： 审题、选框架、填主题词 。 <nobr 段落</nobr <nobr 句数</nobr <nobr 字数</nobr <nobr 任务</nobr <nobr 开篇首句</nobr :--- :--- :--- :--- :--- <nobr 第一段</nobr 3-4 40-50 描述 + 点题 As is vividly depicted in the picture, ... ／ The chart presents ... <nobr 第二段</nobr 5-8 80-100 只论证 First and foremost ... ／ Furthermore ... ／ Last but not least ... <nobr 第三段</nobr 2-3 30-40 只收束 From what has been discussed above, ... ／ In conclusion, ... 三条死规矩 ： 1. 首段只描述 + 点题 ，不写建议。 2. 第二段是唯一必须写满的段落 （80-100 词），首尾两段靠模板顶住。 3. 全文 160-200 词 ：写不满先补数据或举例，写超了先删首段的细节句。 考前三天怎么用 ： 1. 第一天：通读第 1、2 页，把三段骨架与审题三问背下来。 2. 第二天：背第 3～8 页的每段模板句，配第 9～11 页的扩展句式。 3. 第三天：默写第 13～15 页的五篇范文，再扫第 12 页的十处错点。 <div style="page-break-after: always;" </div 第 2 页 · 审题三问与模板分流 审题三问 ├─ 问1 是图画还是图表？ │ ├─ 图画：单主体 → 首段三句版 │ │ 双主体 / 双图 → 四句框架 或 两幅图模板 │ └─ 图表：动态趋势（有时间轴、有升降）→ 趋势变化类模板 │ 静态比例（一张饼 / 一张表分几块）→ 比例构成类模板 ├─ 问2 话题什么性质？ │ ├─ 正面（好品质·好现象）→ 第二段【意义分析】 │ ├─ 负面（不良风气·社会问题）→ 第二段【原因分析】 │ └─ 中性事物（AI·网络·手机）→ 第二段【利弊分析】 └─ 问3 落点在哪个层面？（定尾段） ├─ 个人成长 → 意义价值类·微观个人 ├─ 社会层面（环境·文化·经济）→ 意义价值类·宏观社会 └─ 具体问题待解决 → 问题解决类（提高意识 + 诉诸立法） 两个判据 ： 1. 褒贬判据 ：画中人被赞扬 → 走意义；现象被讽刺 → 走原因；事物有两面 → 走利弊。 2. 图表判据 ：横轴是 时间 → 趋势类；横轴是 类别 → 比例类。 定完三问，立刻在草稿纸写下三行 ： 1. 主题词（英文，如 optimism / innovation / environmental protection）。 2. 首段要报的两个数据或两处细节。 3. 第二段三条角度的中文关键词（如"质量提高 / 观念转变 / 价格优势"）。 模板分流速查 ： <nobr 题目类型</nobr <nobr 首段用</nobr <nobr 中段用</nobr <nobr 尾段用</nobr :--- :--- :--- :--- <nobr 图画·单主体</nobr 第 3 页 一幅图三句版 意义 / 原因 / 利弊 第 8 页 总结或建议 <nobr 图画·双主体</nobr 第 3 页 双主体总述 + 对比衔接 意义 / 原因 / 利弊 第 8 页 总结或建议 <nobr 图表·趋势</nobr 第 4 页 趋势变化类 第 5 页 原因分析 第 8 页 图表预测 <nobr 图表·比例</nobr 第 4 页 比例构成类 第 5 页 原因分析 第 8 页 图表预测 <div style="page-break-after: always;" </div 第 3 页 · 第一段模板（图画作文） ① 图画总述 1. As is vividly depicted in the picture, 主体 is / are doing sth. （As 定语从句指代整句 · 句首即亮点） 例（范文一 ①）：As is vividly depicted in the picture, two men show different attitudes when they see a bottle lying on the ground with water flowing out. 2. As is clearly depicted in the picture, ... （同式变体，副词可换 vividly / clearly） 例（范文四 ①）：As is clearly depicted in the picture, on a lake two tourists are sightseeing on a boat. ② 细节描述 3. The most striking feature is that + 句子 （主系表 + 表语从句 · "最显著的特点是"） 例（范文四 ②）：The most striking feature is that they are throwing rubbish casually into the lake, on which there has been already a lot of disgusting litter. 4. Noticeably, 主体 + 动作 （过渡副词 · 由总述转入细节） 例（范文一 ②）：Noticeably, a man covers his face with a hand and complains "All is gone!". 5. In contrast, ... （对比衔接 · 双主体题的第二句） 例（范文一 ③）：In contrast, the other man says excitedly that luckily there is still a little water, reaching for the bottle. 6. ..., 分词（表伴随） （非谓语 · 主句写主要动作，次要动作降级） 例（范文一 ③）：句尾的 reaching for the bottle。 ③ 引向主题（首段第 3 句） 7. There is no doubt that its symbolic / intended meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. （形式主语 + 主语从句 + 分词后置定语 · 由画面转向主题） 例（范文四 ③）：There is no doubt that its intended meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. 8. Just as the title goes, "..." （引述 · 图画文字说明） 例（范文一 ④）：Just as the title goes, "Attitude is everything.". ④ 备用句式 9. Depicted / Shown in the picture is / are + 主体 （完全倒装 · 比 The picture depicts 更书面） 例（补充例句）：Depicted in the picture is an American girl with smile and in Chinese traditional costumes. 10. In the first drawing, ... . By contrast, in the second picture, ... . （两图对照 · 双图题专用） 例（补充例句）：In the first drawing, the flower is in full bloom under the protection of the greenhouse; by contrast, in the second picture, it withers in the storm. 11. We are informed that + 文字说明 （被动 · 两幅图模板第 3 句） 例（补充例句）：We are informed that love is like a lamp, which is brighter in darker places. 首段注意 ：图画作文首段 只描述 + 点题 ，2-4 句即可；用词求"有色彩"（complain 代替 say、rush 代替 run、wither 代替 die），句法求"整合分句"（with 复合结构、分词状语）。 <div style="page-break-after: always;" </div 第 4 页 · 第一段模板（图表作文） ① 判型 ：横轴是时间、有升降 → 趋势变化类；一张饼 / 一张表分成几块 → 比例构成类。 ② 趋势变化类 1. The chart presents information about / differences between / results of an investigation on ... （图表总述通用式，presents 可换 shows） 例（范文三 ①）：The chart presents the results of an investigation on the market shares of different car brands in the domestic market between 2008 and 2009. 2. The chart presents results of an investigation on the significant changes in terms of the number / percentage of 主体 in ... during the time period from xx to xx. （趋势变化类总述句） 例（补充例句）：The chart presents results of an investigation on the significant changes in terms of the percentage of students studying abroad during the time period from 2015 to 2024. 3. To be specific, the past X years witnessed a remarkable increase in ... from approximately xx to nearly xx. （拟人化主语 · 细节句一） 例（范文三 ②）：To be specific, the past two years witnessed a dramatic decline in the market share of Japanese cars from 35% to about 25%. 4. ..., and that of ... remained stable at 15%. （that of 替代重复名词 · 一降一稳并进一句） 例（范文三 ②）：..., and that of American cars remained stable at 15%. 5. On the contrary, the percentage of ... increased greatly from 25% to nearly 35%. （对照转折 · 细节句二） 例（范文三 ③）：On the contrary, the percentage of home-made cars increased greatly from 25% to nearly 35%. 6. And it can be noticed that ... caught up with and surpassed ... in 2009. （抓典型 · 首段收尾必加） 例（范文三 ④）：And it can be noticed that the share of domestic cars caught up with and surpassed that of Japanese cars in 2009. ③ 比例构成类 7. The chart clearly presents different proportions concerning . （比例总述） 例（范文五 ①）：The chart clearly presents different proportions concerning the career choices of college graduates. 8. As can be seen, the proportion of is 45%, being the highest. （分词作状语 · 突出最高项） 例（范文五 ②）：As can be seen, the proportion of those who choose to pursue a master degree is 45%, being the highest. 9. And account for 35%, followed by with a proportion of 20%. （account for + followed by · 依次排列） 例（范文五 ③）：And those who seek jobs account for 35%, followed by those who start their own business with a proportion of 20%. 10. The proportions of A, B and C are 45%, 35% and 20% respectively. （respectively · 并列报比例） 例（补充例句）：As can be seen, the proportions of graduates choosing further study, employment and business are 45%, 35% and 20% respectively. 11. What is noticeable is that account(s) for 20%. （主语从句 · 合并同类项、突出某个要素） 例（范文五 ④）：What is noticeable is that the percentage of graduates starting their own business has doubled in the past five years. ④ 词块 ：市场份额 = the proportion of ... in the market （例：范文三 ① 的 market shares of different car brands）。 图表三戒 ：只报趋势与典型、不逐项报数；柱子无数据标签时按刻度目测并取整（from 35% to about 25%）；一升一降用 and that of ... remained stable 并进一句。 <div style="page-break-after: always;" </div 第 5 页 · 第二段模板（一）主题句与原因分析 ① 主题句三式（点明主题） 1. Undoubtedly, the drawing has essentially revealed a problem / topic much concerned in our current life that + 句子. （同位语从句 · 图画题最常用） 例（范文二 ②）：Undoubtedly, the drawing has essentially revealed a social problem much concerned in our current life that some adult children try to shun the responsibility of supporting their aged parents. 2. Undoubtedly, the drawing has essentially revealed a topic much concerned in our current life—the significance of 主题词. （破折号同位语 · 抽象主题用） 例（范文一 ⑤）：... much concerned in our current life—the significance of an optimistic mindset. 3. We are supposed to place our attention on the obvious problem revealed in the cartoon: 现象. （图表 / 图画点问题） 例（范文四 ④）：We are supposed to place our attention on the obvious problem revealed in the cartoon: some people ignore the protection of our environment. ② 原因段的四步骨架 4. What contributes to the above trend reflected in the chart? （设问 · 引出原因） 例（范文三 ⑤）：What contributes to the above trend reflected in the chart? 5. As far as I am concerned, two / three possible factors can be figured out. （表态 + 总述） 例（范文三 ⑥）：As far as I am concerned, two possible factors can be figured out. 6. Undoubtedly, the drawing has essentially revealed a social problem much concerned in our current life that some adult children try to shun the responsibility of supporting their aged parents. The reasons for the phenomenon may be complicated, but we can, to a large extent, ascribe it to the following interrelated factors. To begin with, this undesirable phenomenon of maltreatment of the elders can be attributed to the absence of people's consciousness of traditional value of family in modern life. Moreover, relevant laws and regulations might not have been strictly enforced to prevent people from shrugging off their social obligations. It is high time we placed great emphasis on the unpleasant phenomenon. To begin with, relevant laws and regulations should be made to severely punish those who shun the responsibility. In addition, it is essential to cultivate the awareness among the young adults that respecting and supporting the old is always a virtue of Chinese culture. Only in this way can we curb the current evil phenomenon revealed in the picture. 两篇的骨架对照 ：正面题 =（描图）→（主题句 + 意义总领 + 三条意义）→（套话 + 态度 + 展望）；负面题 =（描图）→（主题句 + 归因总领 + 两条原因）→（high time + 两条建议 + Only 倒装）。 <div style="page-break-after: always;" </div 第 14 页 · 范文三、范文四（图表·趋势 / 图画·环保） 范文三 · 图表·趋势变化类（轿车市场份额题，202 词） The chart presents the results of an investigation on the market shares of different car brands in the domestic market between 2008 and 2009. To be specific, the past two years witnessed a dramatic decline in the market share of Japanese cars from 35% to about 25%, and that of American cars remained stable at 15%. On the contrary, the percentage of home-made cars increased greatly from 25% to nearly 35%. And it can be noticed that the share of domestic cars caught up with and surpassed that of Japanese cars in 2009. What contributes to the above trend reflected in the chart? As far as I am concerned, two possible factors can be figured out. First and foremost, the phenomenon may be closely related to the fact that, along with Chinese prospering economy, technologies in the car industry are undergoing dramatic advancement, which contributes to the improvement of national cars in various aspects, such as appearance, performance and security. Last but not least, it is speculated that perhaps the current situation can be ascribed to the advantage of price for home-made cars, which meets the need of average families in China. In conclusion, it can be predicted that the market share of our domestic cars would continue to increase. 范文四 · 图画·负面（湖上游船扔垃圾 → 环保，232 词） As is clearly depicted in the picture, on a lake two tourists are sightseeing on a boat. The most striking feature is that they are throwing rubbish casually into the lake, on which there has been already a lot of disgusting litter. There is no doubt that its intended meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. We are supposed to place our attention on the obvious problem revealed in the cartoon: some people ignore the protection of our environment. Why does this phenomenon appear? Several possible reasons for it can be figured out. First and foremost, the phenomenon may be closely related to the fact that some people are essentially selfish without consideration of others' interests. Furthermore, inadequate advertisement from social media can also contribute to some extent to unpleasant manners in public. Last but not least, it is speculated that perhaps the current situation can be ascribed to unenforced supervision and regulation. From what has been discussed above, it is urgent to take some immediate and effective measures. On one hand, it is advised to continue to expand promotions in communities and schools so as to bring people into realization of the importance and instancy of protecting environment. On the other hand, more rules are expected to be made and carried out by authorities concerned to restrain environmental damage. People must work in joint efforts to create sustainable surroundings. 图表 ↔ 图画的区别 ：图表首段是"读数 + 抓典型"，图画首段是"描图 + 细节 + 引向主题"；第二段两者共用原因三连与利弊分析，尾段两者共用建议与展望。 <div style="page-break-after: always;" </div 第 15 页 · 范文五、素材链、考场流程与交卷清单 范文五 · 图表·比例构成类（毕业去向比例段落示范，约 95 词） The chart clearly presents different proportions concerning the career choices of college graduates. As can be seen, the proportion of those who choose to pursue a master degree is 45%, being the highest. And those who seek jobs account for 35%, followed by those who start their own business with a proportion of 20%. What is noticeable is that the percentage of graduates starting their own business has doubled in the past five years, which can be attributed to the growing awareness of innovation and the favorable policies of the government. ① 六大主题的角度骨架（正面题用"意义"，负面题用"归因"） <nobr 主题</nobr <nobr 论述角度骨架</nobr <nobr 落点</nobr :--- :--- :--- <nobr 文化教育</nobr 事物属性 → 宏观意义 → 微观意义 态度三条 + 行动两条 <nobr 经济生活</nobr 趋势 → 对生活的影响（就业收入·生活水平·消费） 国家政策 / 科技创新 / 人才培养 <nobr 环境保护</nobr 问题归因（内因 · 外因） 企业社会六条 + 个人两条 <nobr 运动健康</nobr 重要性 → 如何保持 / 提升 个人习惯 + 休闲放松 + 社会措施 <nobr 人生哲理</nobr 品质的重要性 → 如何培养 思想意识 + 奋斗行动 <nobr 道德伦理</nobr 社会风尚：重要性 ／ 不良风气：归因 + 解决 社会发展 + 个人 ② 图表三类话题的论述链（第二段直接照搬） 1. 消费生活 ：社会进步 → 观念 / 需求转变 → 人们更重视 / 更愿意做某事。 2. 科技产品 ：经济发展 → 科技进步 → 产品先进 / 多样 / 多功能 / 高质量 → 生活便利 / 满足需求。 3. 个人发展 ：竞争激烈·挑战多·压力大 → 个人做某事 → 增长知识 / 积累经验 / 开阔视野 / 提升能力 → 竞争力 → 机会 → 个人发展。 ③ 考场 35 分钟流程 0-2min 审题三问（图画/图表 · 正/负/中性 · 落点）+ 写主题词 2-5min 列提纲：首段两个数据或细节 + 第二段三条角度关键词 5-35min 套框架成文：首段 3-4 句 → 二段 5-8 句 → 尾段 2-3 句 35-38min 通读检查：十处高频错点 + 字数 + 段落分明 ④ 交卷前 60 秒清单 1. 三段的活儿有没有串（首段写建议？尾段塞新例子？）。 2. 第二段有没有 总领句 + 层次词 （First and foremost / Furthermore / Last but not least）。 3. 尾段有没有 回扣主题 （重申 / 预测 / 展望）。 4. 十处高频错点扫一遍，重点：importance should be attached to、主谓一致、Only 倒装、high time + 过去式。 5. 字数 160-200 词、三段分明、字迹清楚。 最后一句话 ：框架背熟 + 主题词填对 + 三处亮点（一句倒装、一句从句、一个好词），就是稳稳的高分卷。

pages.text: <h2 align="center" 论述型作文·图画作文高分速成</h2 本讲核心 ：速成 = 背框架 → 套主题词 。考场只做两件事—— 审题立意 （定主题词/中心句、定描图要点、定论述框架与角度）与 代入英文框架填充成文 ；框架、模板句全部提前背好。全讲给三套东西：① 三段 布局表 （句数/字数）② 每段 可填空模板 （首段 2 版、中间段 3 类、尾段 2 类）③ 两套实战演练 （抽象主题"创新"＋负向现象"环保"）。 与相邻两页的分工 ：本文是 考场速成版模板 （框架 + 填充）； 论述型作文-三段写作模板.md 是通用三段骨架与范文； 写作句式.md 按功能给全部可替换句式； 图表作文（数据类） 另有 论述型作文-图表作文速成.md （首段按数据类型选模板、第二段按话题类型取论述思路）。 （一）速成总流程与三段时间分配 图画作文高分速成步骤 ： 1. 审题立意 （2 分钟） 2. 编列提纲 （3 分钟） 3. 布局 + 成文 （30 分钟） 考场优化步骤 （布局与写作框架已提前背熟）： 布局 & 写作框架已定（背模板） → 审题立意 → 编列提纲 → 套用框架成文 审题立意三步 （全讲收尾页的总结）： 1. 确定主题词或中心句 ——先判是 反映现象 还是 陈述观点 2. 确定首段描图要点 3. 确定论述框架和论述角度 → 代入英文框架， 填充成文 一句话 ：考场时间不是用来"想句式"的，而是用来 审题 + 选框架 + 填主题词 。 （二）三段高分布局（句数与字数） <nobr 段落</nobr <nobr 句数</nobr <nobr 字数</nobr <nobr 内容分工</nobr :--- :--- :--- :--- <nobr 起始段</nobr 3-4 40-50 Part1 如图所示，概述图画<br Part2 围绕主题，细节描写<br Part3 借助中文，引向主题 <nobr 中间段</nobr 5-8 80-100 Part1 揭示主题，统领下文<br Part2 围绕主题，展开论证 <nobr 结尾段</nobr 2-3 30-40 重申主题 / 提出建议，展望未来 口径 ：三段合计约 150-190 词，落在 Directions 的 160-200 词区间内； 中间段是唯一必须"写满"的段落 ，首尾都可以用模板句顶住。 （三）1.1 首段高分框架（两版模板） 一、一幅图模板 1. As is vividly depicted in the picture, 整体描述. 2. The most striking feature is that 细节描述. 3. There is no doubt that its symbolic / intended meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. 二、两幅图模板 1. As the picture here conspicuously depicts, 整体描述. 2. In the first drawing, 第一幅图画细节描述. By contrast, in the second picture, 第二幅图画细节描述. 3. We are informed that 文字说明. 兼容说明 ：本讲首段走 三句版 （总述 → 最显著特征 → 意义深思），与《图画作文首段》的 四句框架 （总体描述 → 细节 1 → 细节 2 → 文字说明）并不冲突—— 单图细节少就用三句版，双图/细节多就用四句框架 ；三句版的第 ③ 句相当于"搭桥"，四句框架的文字说明可改写为 We are informed that ... 。 易错点 ： There is no doubt that ... should be given a deep consideration 中 be given 是被动 （寓意"被"思考）； its symbolic meaning subtly conveyed 中 conveyed 是过去分词后置定语 （"被传递的"寓意）。 （四）1.2 中间段高分框架（三类模板） 一、先选框架：按主题类型三选一 中间段三类框架模板 ├─ ① 原因分析 ← 负面现象（问题、不良风气） ├─ ② 意义分析 ← 正面现象（品质、好做法） └─ ③ 利弊分析 ← 两面性话题（科技、AI 等"双刃剑"） 判据 ：主题词是 问题 （污染、失礼、不诚信）→ 原因分析；是 品质/好做法 （创新、坚持、环保意识）→ 意义分析；是 中性事物 （AI、网络、手机）→ 利弊分析。 二、模板 A：原因分析（①引出问题 → ②设问 → ③总述 → ④⑤⑥三条原因） 1. We are supposed to place our attention on, instead of its (funny) appearance, the phenomenon reflected / revealed in the cartoon that some people pay little attention to sth. 2. Why does this phenomenon appear? 3. Several possible reasons for it can be figured out. 4. First and foremost, the phenomenon may be closely related to the fact that + 句子. 5. Furthermore, 原因二 can also contribute to some extent to 主题. 6. Last but not least, it is speculated that perhaps the current situation can be ascribed to 原因三. 技巧 ：④⑤⑥ 就是 内因 → 外因 两条腿（老师原话"一般我们都从内因和外因两大角度"）——内因（个人意识、自私、道德）走 ④，外因（媒体宣传、监管、制度）走 ⑤⑥。 三、模板 B：意义分析（②③④三层） 1. First and foremost, it is universally held that sth contributes a lot to 意义一. For example, with sth, we are more likely to do sth. 2. In the second place, we all share an idea that sth also plays a vital role in 意义二, which can be easily demonstrated by the fact that + 句子. 3. Last but not least, according to some research findings, by doing sth, there is a high possibility that we could do sth. 技巧 ：三条意义按 由近及远 排——个人（individual growth）→ 社会（social progress）→ 科技/人类（science and technology）；每条都自带"证明"手段： For example / demonstrated by the fact that / according to some research findings 。 四、模板 C：利弊分析（①引言 → ②弊 → ③个人角度 → ④社会角度） 1. The picture is fairly thought-provoking, which intends to reveal a much-discussed question about the advantages and disadvantages of sth. As far as I am concerned, we cannot tell whether sth is good or bad unless we properly take advantage of it. 2. Improper use or even misuse of sth will of course result in some negative impacts on us. 3. Judging from individual perspective, it may lead to sth. For example, when we ignore the possible undesirable influence of sth, we may be faced with ... . 4. Judging from the social angle, the development of sth without supervision from departments concerned or reasonable restrictions by rules is bound to harm social interests and hinder social progress. 技巧 ：利弊段的立场句是 ① 的 we cannot tell whether sth is good or bad unless we properly take advantage of it —— 不站队、只谈"善用" ，比"利弊各打五十大板"更高级。 五、填充角度（把 sth 换成主题词后，从这里取内容） 具体意义分析角度 ： <nobr 角度</nobr 可填内容 :--- :--- <nobr 个人发展</nobr 目标 / 梦想 / 成功 / 自我实现 <nobr 三子角度</nobr ① 获得 / 迎接 / 抓住机遇 ② 面对 / 应对困难、挑战、压力 ③ 又快又好——效率 / 效果 具体原因分析常见维度 （讲义带英文对照）： <nobr 层面</nobr 中文落点 英文表达 :--- :--- :--- <nobr 个人</nobr 自私自利 selfish <nobr 个人</nobr 道德缺失 moral decline / absence of social morality <nobr 个人</nobr 意识不足 insufficient awareness <nobr 社会</nobr 制度不完善 systems with flaws <nobr 社会</nobr 监管不力 unenforced supervision and regulation <nobr 社会</nobr 媒体引导宣传不足 inadequate advertisement from social media （五）1.3 尾段高分布局（两类模板） 结尾段常用框架 ：① 建议措施 ② 总结概括 （按中间段走"原因/利弊"还是"意义"来选）。 一、建议措施模板（对应负面现象 / 利弊话题） 1. From what has been discussed above, it is urgent to take some immediate and effective measures. （引出建议） 2. In the first place, we are expected to raise the awareness of the significance of 主题. （建议①：提高意识） 3. In the second place, more rules are supposed to be made and carried out by the government to restrain people from doing sth and favorable policies are needed to encourage more people to engage in sth. （建议②：立法约束 + 政策鼓励） 4. Only in this way can we 展望未来. （收尾） "展望未来"三选一 ： - enjoy a promising future （享受美好未来） - live in harmony with nature / others （与自然/他人和谐相处） - succeed in maintaining sustainability （成功保持可持续性） 技巧 ：建议句一律" 建议角度 + 目的 "成对写—— 扩大宣传 → 增强意识 、 制定实施更多规则 → 约束 ，句子立刻有逻辑而不是堆套话。 二、总结概括模板（对应意义分析 / 抽象主题） 1. From what has been mentioned above, we may reasonably come to the conclusion that 重申主题的重要性. 2. Those with great accomplishments are living proof that it is 主题 that matters a lot in realization of dreams at every stage of individual life. 技巧 ：② 是 强调句 （ it is 主题 that matters a lot ）+ living proof （活生生的证明），比 It is important 有分量得多；把 individual life 扩成 individual life or the whole process of the world advancement 即可拔高到人类层面。 （六）实战演练一：抽象主题（选课系统 → 创新） 漫画 ：一名学生坐在电脑前操作"选课系统"；左侧气泡"知识新 有创新 有难度……"，右侧气泡"给分高 易通过 作业少……"。 主题/论点 ：年轻人要追求创新，不断学习新知识， 要走出舒适区、勇于挑战 。 一、Para.1 描述要点 → 框架填充 - （1）总体概括 ：一个大学生在选课系统中选课。 - （2）细节描述 ：他在两种类型的课程如何选择方面纠结。 - "纠结"词块 ：do not know / have no idea about sth / be confused about sth. 1. As is vividly depicted in the picture, a college student is selecting a course from the system. 2. The most striking feature is that he is quite confused about which kind to choose: the one that is easy to pass with less homework but a high score or the difficult one with new knowledge and innovation. 3. There is no doubt that its intended meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. 【仿写】 （同模板换题材：毕业岔路口） ① As is vividly depicted in the picture, a group / number of college students are standing on a road. ② The most striking feature is that they are quite confused about which road to choose: seeking jobs, pursuing a master degree, going abroad, or starting business on their own. 二、Para.2 框架填充（意义分析） - 框架选择 ：本主题偏抽象概念 → 走 意义分析 （若讨论"双刃剑"式事物则换利弊分析）。 1. 【表达 2】Without any doubt, the purpose of the cartoon is to show us that young men are supposed to be innovative and persist in learning new knowledge. And it is also hinted that the young need to walk out of the comfort zone and be courageous to meet challenges. （点明主题） 2. First and foremost, it is universally held that innovation contributes a lot to individual growth. For example, with this ability, we are more likely to grasp opportunities. （意义一 · 个人） 3. In the second place, we all share an idea that innovation also plays a vital role in social progress, which can be easily demonstrated by the fact that almost every social reform results from personal creativity. （意义二 · 社会） 4. Last but not least, according to some research findings, by acquiring new knowledge persistently, there is a higher possibility that we could make significant breakthroughs in science and technology so as to efficiently and effectively solve problems that humans are faced with. （意义三 · 科技/人类） 注意 ： with this ability, we are more likely to grasp opportunities 是把抽象主题词（innovation） 具象成"能力" 再谈好处——抽象主题必须这样落地，否则整段空转。 三、Para.3 总结评论（与 Para.2 保持一致性） 1. From what has been mentioned above, we may reasonably come to the conclusion that innovation does bring us various benefits and it is now one of the most important spirits in our development. 2. Those with great accomplishments are living proof that it is innovation that matters a lot in realization of dreams at every stage of individual life or in the whole process of the world advancement. （七）实战演练二：负向现象（湖上观光 → 环保） 漫画 ：湖面上一艘小船载着数名游客（有人撑篙），湖面漂浮大量垃圾（塑料瓶、易拉罐等）。 标题「旅程之"余"」，判为负向现象。 一、Para.1 描述要点 → 框架填充 - （1）总体概括 ：两名游客坐船观光游览。 - "观光游览"词块 ： sightsee / tour around / enjoy scenery - （2）细节描述 ：① 他们在向湖中扔垃圾。② 湖面漂着很多垃圾。 1. As is clearly depicted in the picture, on a lake two tourists are sightseeing on a boat. 2. The most striking feature is that they are throwing rubbish casually into the lake, on which there has been already a lot of disgusting litter. 3. There is no doubt that its intended meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. 技巧 ：② 用 on which there has been already a lot of ... 把"扔垃圾"和"湖面已有垃圾" 并进一句 （介词 + which 定从），细节句就写满了。 二、Para.2 框架填充（原因分析模板） 1. We are supposed to place our attention on the obvious problem revealed in the cartoon: some people ignore the protection of our environment. （点明问题） 2. Why does this phenomenon appear? Several possible reasons for it can be figured out. （设问 + 总述） 3. First and foremost, the phenomenon may be closely related to the fact that some people are essentially selfish without consideration of others' interests. （内因 · 自私自利） 4. Furthermore, inadequate advertisement from social media can also contribute to some extent to unpleasant manners in public. （外因 · 媒体宣传不足） 5. Last but not least, it is speculated that perhaps the current situation can be ascribed to unenforced supervision and regulation. （外因 · 监管不力） 技巧 ：三条原因分别落在 个人素质 → 媒体宣传 → 监管制度 ，正是布局表里"内因 + 外因"的标准配比，也对应（四）五的维度表。 三、Para.3 提出建议措施（与 Para.2 保持一致性） 1. From what has been discussed above, it is urgent to take some immediate and effective measures. （引出建议） 2. On one hand, it is advised to continue to expand promotions in communities and schools so as to bring people into realization of the importance and instancy of protecting environment. （建议①：扩大宣传 → 增强意识） 3. On the other hand, more rules are expected to be made and carried out by authorities concerned to restrain environmental damage. （建议②：有关部门立规 → 约束） 4. People must work in joint efforts to create sustainable surroundings. （号召 / 展望未来） 技巧 ：建议两条正好与 Para.2 的原因 一一对应 ——媒体宣传不足 → 扩大宣传；监管不力 → 出台并执行规则。 "与 para.2 保持一致性"是尾段的评分点 。 四、两篇演练的完整装配稿（按讲义逐句拼合） 演练二·环保（讲义逐句拼合约 232 词；考场删去一条原因、一处细节即落到约 195 词） ： As is clearly depicted in the picture, on a lake two tourists are sightseeing on a boat. The most striking feature is that they are throwing rubbish casually into the lake, on which there has been already a lot of disgusting litter. There is no doubt that its intended meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. We are supposed to place our attention on the obvious problem revealed in the cartoon: some people ignore the protection of our environment. Why does this phenomenon appear? Several possible reasons for it can be figured out. First and foremost, the phenomenon may be closely related to the fact that some people are essentially selfish without consideration of others' interests. Furthermore, inadequate advertisement from social media can also contribute to some extent to unpleasant manners in public. Last but not least, it is speculated that perhaps the current situation can be ascribed to unenforced supervision and regulation. From what has been discussed above, it is urgent to take some immediate and effective measures. On one hand, it is advised to continue to expand promotions in communities and schools so as to bring people into realization of the importance and instancy of protecting environment. On the other hand, more rules are expected to be made and carried out by authorities concerned to restrain environmental damage. People must work in joint efforts to create sustainable surroundings. 演练一·创新（讲义逐句拼合约 291 词；抽象主题示范，考场按布局表删减到约 190 词） ： As is vividly depicted in the picture, a college student is selecting a course from the system. The most striking feature is that he is quite confused about which kind to choose: the one that is easy to pass with less homework but a high score or the difficult one with new knowledge and innovation. There is no doubt that its intended meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. Without any doubt, the purpose of the cartoon is to show us that young men are supposed to be innovative and persist in learning new knowledge. And it is also hinted that the young need to walk out of the comfort zone and be courageous to meet challenges. First and foremost, it is universally held that innovation contributes a lot to individual growth. For example, with this ability, we are more likely to grasp opportunities. In the second place, we all share an idea that innovation also plays a vital role in social progress, which can be easily demonstrated by the fact that almost every social reform results from personal creativity. Last but not least, according to some research findings, by acquiring new knowledge persistently, there is a higher possibility that we could make significant breakthroughs in science and technology so as to efficiently and effectively solve problems that humans are faced with. From what has been mentioned above, we may reasonably come to the conclusion that innovation does bring us various benefits and it is now one of the most important spirits in our development. Those with great accomplishments are living proof that it is innovation that matters a lot in realization of dreams at every stage of individual life or in the whole process of the world advancement. 用法 ：装配稿用于 看清"框架 → 成文"的完整链路 ；考场不必逐句照抄，按（二）布局表的句数与字数删减（首段 3 句、中间段 5-8 句、尾段 2-3 句）。 （八）本讲总结 知识结构 ： 图画作文高分速成 ├─ 速成步骤：审题立意 2min → 编列提纲 3min → 布局+成文 30min │ 三步：①定主题词/中心句（现象 or 观点）②定描图要点 ③定论述框架与角度 → 代入框架填充成文 ├─ 三段布局：起始段 3-4 句/40-50 词｜中间段 5-8 句/80-100 词｜结尾段 2-3 句/30-40 词 ├─ 1.1 首段框架 │ ├─ 一幅图：As is vividly depicted… → The most striking feature is that… → There is no doubt that its symbolic meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. │ └─ 两幅图：As the picture here conspicuously depicts… → In the first drawing…, By contrast, in the second picture… → We are informed that… ├─ 1.2 中间段三类模板 │ ├─ 原因分析：①引出问题 ②Why does this phenomenon appear? ③Several possible reasons… ④内因 ⑤外因一 ⑥外因二 │ ├─ 意义分析：②个人（contributes a lot to）③社会（plays a vital role in）④科技/人类（by doing sth, there is a high possibility…） │ └─ 利弊分析：①引言（cannot tell whether…unless we properly take advantage of it）②弊 ③个人角度 ④社会角度 ├─ 1.3 尾段两类模板 │ ├─ 建议措施：①引出建议（it is urgent to take measures）②提高意识 ③立法约束+政策鼓励 ④Only in this way 展望未来 │ └─ 总结概括：①come to the conclusion that… ②it is 主题 that matters a lot（living proof） └─ 实战演练两套：抽象主题（选课系统→创新）｜负向现象（湖上观光→环保） 模板句速查 ： <nobr 用途</nobr <nobr 模板句</nobr :--- :--- 首段（一幅图） As is vividly depicted in the picture, ... / The most striking feature is that ... / There is no doubt that its symbolic meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration. 首段（两幅图） As the picture here conspicuously depicts, ... / In the first drawing, ... By contrast, in the second picture, ... / We are informed that ... 引出待分析现象 We are supposed to place our attention on, instead of its funny appearance, the phenomenon ... that ... 原因段起手 Why does this phenomenon appear? Several possible reasons for it can be figured out. 原因三条 First and foremost, the phenomenon may be closely related to the fact that ... / Furthermore, ... can also contribute to some extent to ... / Last but not least, it is speculated that perhaps ... can be ascribed to ... 意义三条 it is universally held that ... contributes a lot to ... / we all share an idea that ... plays a vital role in ..., demonstrated by the fact that ... / by doing sth, there is a high possibility that we could ... 利弊段 The picture is fairly thought-provoking, which intends to reveal a much-discussed question about the advantages and disadvantages of sth. / Improper use or even misuse of sth will result in ... / Judging from individual perspective ... / Judging from the social angle ... is bound to harm social interests and hinder social progress. 点题两连 Without any doubt, the purpose of the cartoon is to show us that ... And it is also hinted that ... 引出建议 From what has been discussed above, it is urgent to take some immediate and effective measures. 建议两条 In the first place, we are expected to raise the awareness of the significance of ... / In the second place, more rules are supposed to be made and carried out ... / On one hand, it is advised to expand promotions ... so as to bring people into realization of ... / On the other hand, more rules are expected to be made and carried out by authorities concerned to restrain ... 号召展望 People must work in joint efforts to create sustainable surroundings. / Only in this way can we enjoy a promising future（live in harmony with nature / succeed in maintaining sustainability）. 总结概括 From what has been mentioned above, we may reasonably come to the conclusion that ... / Those with great accomplishments are living proof that it is ... that matters a lot in realization of dreams ... 话题词块备份 ：selecting a course from the system（在选课系统中选课）、be confused about which kind to choose（纠结选哪种）、walk out of the comfort zone（走出舒适区）、grasp opportunities（抓住机遇）、almost every social reform results from personal creativity（几乎每次社会变革都源于个人创造力）、make significant breakthroughs in science and technology（取得重大科技突破）、sightsee / tour around / enjoy scenery（观光游览）、throw rubbish casually into the lake（随手往湖里扔垃圾）、disgusting litter（恶心的垃圾）、unpleasant manners in public（公共场合不良行为）、unenforced supervision and regulation（监管不力）、protecting environment（保护环境）、create sustainable surroundings（创造可持续的环境）。 图 ：选课系统漫画（"知识新/有创新/有难度" vs "给分高/易通过/作业少"）对应"追求创新、走出舒适区"；湖上游船扔垃圾漫画（标题"旅程之'余'"）对应负向现象"环保"。 讲义笔误订正（按 §13.2 不照抄） ：① innovation does brings us various benefits → does bring （does 后接动词原形）；② Para.2: 点名主题/中心 → 点明主题/中心 ；③ the young need to walk out of the comfort zone be courageous to meet challenges → 两个谓语之间缺连词，应为 ... comfort zone and be courageous ... 。 占位符说明 ：讲义模板中的 sth 是 something 的缩写 ，代表"填入主题词的位置"； 意义一/意义二/原因二 等是内容占位，考场按主题替换。

pages.text: <h2 align="center" 论述型作文·图画作文首段</h2 本讲核心 ：图画作文首段的写法 = 一、首段要求 → 二、首段框架 → 三、首段提分要点 。首段只需 2-4 句 ，任务是把图画"翻译"成文字并引出寓意；提分靠两处—— 用词多"色彩" 与 运用丰富语法结构（整合分句） 。 已成稿模板 ：本讲与 论述型作文-主体段与结论段.md 已压成 论述型作文-三段写作模板.md （三段十二句骨架 + 三篇范文 + 替换词库 + 自查清单），考场可直接套用；另有速成讲 论述型作文-图画作文速成.md （首段 三句版 模板 As is vividly depicted… → The most striking feature is that… → There is no doubt that its symbolic meaning subtly conveyed should be given a deep consideration ）。 （一）首段要求 一、题目要求（Directions 原文） Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should 1) describe the picture briefly , 2) explain its intended meaning and 3) give your comments . 二、三项要求 ↔ 三个段落 <nobr 要求</nobr <nobr 落位</nobr 本讲覆盖 :--- :--- :--- 1) describe the picture briefly 第一段（首段） 本讲全部内容 2) explain its intended meaning 第二段（主体段） 另见 论述型作文-主体段与结论段.md （三）段落主题句 3) give your comments 第三段（尾段） 另见 论述型作文-主体段与结论段.md （四）～（六） 定心丸 ：首段只要求 briefly （简要）描述—— 2-4 句即可 ，不必逐笔描写图画，不必交代全部细节；把笔墨留给第二、三段的论证与建议。 （二）首段框架 一、描图前的三层思考 ① 描图目的：引出图画的 intended meaning（主题 / 内涵 / 寓意） - 描图不是目的， 为寓意作铺垫 才是目的；可借 中文标题 / 文字提示 锁定寓意方向。 ② 描写什么：图中的主体（在什么环境下）在做什么 <nobr 维度</nobr 可选值 :--- :--- <nobr 主体类型</nobr 人 / 物 <nobr 主体数量</nobr 1 个 / 2 个 / 多个 / 一群 <nobr 主体关系</nobr 相似 / 对比（与下文"a. 相似主体 / b. 主体对比"对应） ③ 用英文怎么描图 ——见下文框架句与后续各例的四级升级链。 二、首段四句框架（2-4 句） 首段框架（2-4 句） ├─ 第1句：总体描述 ├─ 第2-3句：细节描述 └─ 第4句：文字说明 1. 第 1 句 · 总体描述 ——点明画面主体在做什么（"这幅图画描绘了……"） 2. 第 2-3 句 · 细节描述 ——展开主体特征、动作状态、环境场景（单主体可省，双主体必给） 3. 第 4 句 · 文字说明 ——图画中的文字 / 标题（ The caption reads, "..." / Just as the title goes, "..." ） 三、第 1 句：引出图画的三式 1. This (set of) drawing(s) vividly portrays + 主体 + who/which + is/are doing sth. （主句 + 定语从句 · 总述"这幅画生动地描绘了……"） - This drawing vividly portrays a young man who is rushing on the track. 2. As is vividly depicted in the picture / cartoon, 主体 is/are doing sth. （As 定语从句指代整句 · 首段首选 ，放句首） - As is vividly depicted in the picture , a young man is rushing with all his effort on the track towards the finishing line. 3. Shown in the picture is a (vivid) scene in which 主体 is/are doing sth. （ 完全倒装 + 定语从句 · 最书面） - Shown in the picture is a vivid scene in which a little lamp is giving off bright light. 技巧 ：三式轮换用， As is vividly depicted in the picture / cartoon, ... 是性价比最高的一式 ——句首即亮点，且后面接任意主体都通顺。 注意 ： As is depicted / As is vividly depicted 中 is 后的动词用 过去分词 （depicted / shown / presented），因为关系代词 As 作主语、图画是"被"描绘的。 四、第 2-3 句：过渡语 由"总体描述"转入"细节描述"时，用一个过渡词起句，层次立刻清楚： 1. To be specific, （具体说来） 2. As can be noticed, （可以看出） 3. Strangely / Ironically, （奇怪的是 / 讽刺的是）——用于画面有反差、有讽刺意味时 五、第 4 句：文字说明 图画中的文字、标题、题词，用下面两式引出： 1. The caption reads, "..." （文字说明 · 图画下方的题字 / 说明文字） - The caption reads , "Love is like a lamp, which is brighter in darker places". 2. Just as the title goes, "..." （标题引入 · 借标题引向主题 ） - Just as the title goes , "One end is another start.". 提示 ：题字本身带寓意时，第 4 句把题字引出来， 第二段顺势承接寓意 ，首尾就自然衔接了。 六、两幅图 / 双主体的衔接 a. 相似主体 （两幅图讲同一件事） 1. In the first photo, .... ／ A man .... 2. Similarly, / Meanwhile, in the second picture, .... ／ the other man .... b. 主体对比 （两人 / 两图态度相反） 1. 句 1. On the contrary / In contrast, 句 2. （对比过渡词起句） 2. 句 1, while 句 2. （while 表对比，一个逗号连成一句） 技巧 ：双主体题（画面里两个人、两种态度）先写" 分开描述 "（一个人……，然而另一个人……），再用上表过渡语把两句扣起来； 对比关系用 In contrast / while ，相似关系用 Similarly / Meanwhile ，不要混用。 （三）例题一：单主体（"终点又是新起点"） 图意 ：一名年轻人在跑道上奔跑，奔向终点线。题字「终点又是新起点」。 四级升级链 （同一句话，逐级提分）： 1. 基本描述 （保底，先写对） - A man is running on the track. 2. 增加修饰语 （主体特征 / 动作状态 —— 锦上添花） - A young man is running with all his effort / hard on the track towards the finishing line . 3. 提升用词 （更贴切 / 形象） - A young man is rushing with all his effort / hard on the track towards the finishing line. 4. 套入框架 （换成首段句式） - As is vividly depicted in the picture , a young man is rushing with all his effort / hard on the track towards the finishing line. 5. 续上寓意 （与第 2 段搭桥） - As is vividly depicted in the picture, a young man is rushing with all his effort / hard on the track towards the finishing line, and does not mean to stop, but rather continue another race at the new start . - Just as the title goes , "One end is another start.". 要点 ： 升序不能用 ——先把基本描述写对（主谓、时态），再依次加修饰、换好词、套框架；一上手就套 As is depicted 却写错主体动作，反而丢分。 易错点 ： run → rush / dash （冲、奔）虽更形象，但 要合乎图意 （画中人有速度线、表情用力才用 rush）；不要为了"高级"而扭曲图意。 （四）例题二：双主体（"半瓶水"） 图意 ：两人面对地上倒翻、水流出的瓶子——左边那人捂着脸说"全完了"，右边那人俯身去捡，说"幸好还剩点儿"。 一、先做拆解（描图前的准备） 1. 场景 ——瓶子倒了，水流出来 2. 主体动作状态 - 主体 1——手捂脸，说"全完了" - 主体 2——伸手捡瓶子，说"幸好还剩点儿" 二、一个主体，多个动作：两条路 <nobr 主体</nobr 动作 :--- :--- 一个人 捂脸 + 说 另一个人 说 + 伸手去捡瓶子 1. ① 用并列 （and 连接两个谓语） - A man covers his face with a hand and complains "All is gone!". 2. ② 用分词表伴随 （主句写主要动作，次要动作用 -ing 挂在后面） - ..., the other man says excitedly that luckily there is still a little water, reaching for the bottle . 三、第 1 句框架（双主体专用） 1. As is depicted in the picture, 双主体 + show different attitudes / have different responses when they do sth. （总述"两人对同一事态度不同"） - As is depicted in the picture, two men show different attitudes when they see a bottle lying on the ground with water flowing out. 注意 ： a bottle lying on the ground with water flowing out 是 with 复合结构 （with + 名词 + 现在分词），一个短语交代"瓶子躺在地上、水正流出"两个信息，比另起一句简洁——首段常用（详见（七））。 四、逐轮升级（同一句的四个版本） 1. 基础版 （只写"说"，内容直白） - A man says "There is nothing left. / It is over. / All is gone!", while the other man says that luckily there is still a little water. 2. 加神态 （副词修饰动词，用词多"色彩"） - A man says with depression "All is gone!", while the other man says excitedly that luckily there is still a little water. 3. 换动词 （ say with depression → complain ） - A man complains "All is gone!", while the other man says excitedly that luckily there is still a little water. - 板书补充：老师另给 exclaim （惊呼、感叹）供替换。 4. 加动作 + 分词伴随 + 对比过渡 （定稿版） - A man covers his face with a hand and complains "All is gone!". In contrast , the other man says excitedly that luckily there is still a little water, reaching for the bottle . 五、【首段示例】（双主体完整首段） As is depicted in the picture, two men show different attitudes when they see a bottle lying on the ground with water flowing out. Noticeably , a man covers his face with a hand and complains "All is gone!". In contrast , the other man says excitedly that luckily there is still a little water, reaching for the bottle. 拆解 ： 1. 第 1 句： 总体描述 （As is depicted... + 双主体 show different attitudes） 2. 第 2-3 句： 细节描述 （Noticeably 引主体 1；In contrast 引主体 2） 3. 三条提分手法齐上： with 复合结构 （lying... with water flowing out）、 并列 + 分词伴随 （covers... and complains / reaching for）、 对比过渡语 （In contrast） （五）演练两篇 一、演练一：油灯（"爱心是一盏灯，在越黑暗的地方越明亮"） 拆解 ： 1. 主体 ：a lamp / an oil lamp 2. 动作 ：shine / give off light / emit light 3. 场景 ：in the darkness 逐级升级 ： 1. 套入框架 + 基本描述 - As is depicted vividly in the cartoon, a lamp is giving off light in the darkness. 2. 增加修饰 （名词前加形容词、名词后加介词短语） - As is depicted vividly in the cartoon, a little lamp is giving off bright light in the vast darkness . 3. 补第 4 句文字说明 - As is depicted vividly in the cartoon, a little lamp is giving off bright light in the vast darkness. The caption reads, "Love is like a lamp, which is brighter in darker places". 提分点 ： a lamp → a little lamp 、 light → bright light 、 darkness → the vast darkness —— 加修饰语 就是首段最快见效的"色彩"。 二、演练二：温室花朵（"温室花朵经不起风雨"） 图意 ：上图花在温室（拱棚）里盛开；下图同一盆花移到棚外雨中，倒伏枯萎。 逐级升级 ： 1. 一盆花，两种场景 （首句框架 + 双场景总述） - As is depicted in the picture, a flower shows different responses / has different results when it is under different circumstances. 2. 具体展开场景一 （用 despite 把"棚内"与"棚外"对照起来） - Noticeably, the flower blooms / is in full bloom / grows well under the protection of the greenhouse, despite the storm outside. 3. 具体展开场景二 （两式：直陈"经不起"或换词"枯萎"） - In contrast, it can not withstand the storm . - 或 In contrast, it withers / dies in the storm . 【首段范文】 As is depicted in the picture, a flower has different results when they are under different circumstances. Noticeably, the flower is in full bloom under the protection of the greenhouse, despite the storm outside. In contrast, it withers in the storm. 拆解 ： 1. 第 1 句总体描述（双场景总述）→ 第 2-3 句细节（Noticeably 场景一 / In contrast 场景二） 2. despite + 名词 一句装两个对立场景； withers 比 dies 更贴切形象（用词"有色彩"） 3. 呼应题字 ：题字"温室花朵经不起风雨"的寓意，正是 in full bloom 与 withers 的对照 （六）提分要点一：用词优化（多"色彩"） 一、增加修饰语 1. a. 名词前后添加修饰成分 ——形容词、介词短语、分词短语、定语从句 - an energetic runner（形容词前置） - a little lamp with a smiling face （介词短语后置） 2. b. 运用副词、介词短语修饰动词 - say proudly / frustratedly / happily / sadly （副词修饰动词） - The flower is in full bloom under the protection of the greenhouse.（介词短语修饰状态） 二、提升用词（同义替换，更贴切 / 形象） 1. say frustratedly → complain （抱怨） 2. run towards the finish line → rush / dash to the finish line （冲、奔） 3. The flower dies. → The flower withers. （枯萎） 4. 【练习】A man is reading a book. - → A man is dedicated to reading.（专心致志于） - → A man is concentrating on reading.（专注于） 技巧 ：用词升级不是换成生僻大词，而是 换成一个更贴切的已有词 —— complain 比 say frustratedly 短，却更形象； withers 比 dies 更符合花的画面。 延伸 ：全篇范围的用词升级（高频话题词升级表、短语替换基础词）见 论述型作文-用词训练.md （四）。 （七）提分要点二：运用丰富语法结构（整合分句） 两个方向 ： 1. 各类从句 （eg. 定语从句） 2. 非谓语结构 （eg. 分词做后置定语 / 分词做状语表伴随） 整合分句的四种手段 —— 目标：把几个短句整合成一句，句子更简洁 ： <nobr 手段</nobr <nobr 适用</nobr <nobr 例</nobr :--- :--- :--- <nobr ①状语从句省略形式</nobr 从句主语 = 主句主语 When exposed to the storm, it fades. <nobr ②介词短语（with）做状语</nobr 表伴随 ... with a hand covering his face <nobr ③分词短语做状语</nobr 一个主体发出不同动作 / 不同主体伴随发生动作 ..., complaining "It is all over". <nobr ④定语从句</nobr 把并列短句挂到名词上 ..., who is crouching in the center of the court. 一、① 状语从句省略形式 构成 ： 状语从句引导词 + 形容词 / 介词短语 / 分词短语 前提 ： 从句的主语和主句主语相同 （否则不能省） 1. 例：当花被暴露在暴风雨中时，花儿凋谢了。 - When exposed to the storm, it fades. - 还原： When it is exposed to the storm , it fades. ——从句主语 it 与主句主语 it 相同，故省去 it is 。 二、② 介词短语（with）做状语（表伴随） 构成 ： with + 名词 + 现在分词 / 过去分词 / 形容词 / 介词短语 1. 例：一个男人手捂着脸，感觉很沮丧。 - a man feels really upset with a hand covering his face 2. 例：瓶子躺在地上，水正流出来。 - a bottle lying on the ground with water flowing out 三、③ 分词短语做状语 两种情形 ： 1. 一个主体，发出不同动作 ——主句写主要动作，其余动作降级为分词 - ..., complaining "It is all over". 2. 不同主体，伴随发生动作 ——用 with 复合结构（见上）或独立主格 四、④ 定语从句 1. 例：从前有座山，山上有座庙，庙里住着一个和尚。 - [ 普通句 ] Long long ago, there was a mountain. On the mountain, there is a temple. In the temple, a monk lives there.（三句并列，松散） - [ 升级句 ] Long long ago, there was a mountain on which there is a temple, where a monk lives .（两处定语从句串成一句） 2. 【综合例】把四种手段用在一句里 - When seeing a bottle lying on the ground with much of the water flowing out , a man feels really upset with a hand covering his face , complaining "It is all over". - 逐段对应： When seeing... ＝①省略形式； lying on the ground ＝分词做后置定语； with much of the water flowing out ＝②with 伴随； with a hand covering his face ＝②with 伴随； complaining... ＝③分词做状语。 3. 【定语从句练习】大儿子把老父亲踢开。老父亲无助地蜷缩在球场中间。 - The elder son kicks away his aged father, who is crouching in the center of the court . - 板书更正： elder → eldest （"大儿子"指三者以上中的长子，用 eldest ；elder 只用于两者比较）。 4. 【练习】一个人坐在台阶上，背包放在地上，说"太累了，我不爬了"。 - A man sits on the step with a backpack on the ground , ... 易错点 ：省略形式的 前提是从句主语与主句主语相同 ——不同主语时不能省（要用 with 复合结构或独立主格）。 易错点 ： elder / eldest 混用——两者比较用 elder，三者及以上之最用 eldest。 （八）本章总结 知识结构 ： 图画作文首段 ├─ 一、首段要求 │ └─ Directions：160-200 词；①describe briefly ②explain intended meaning ③give comments │ （首段只做第①项，briefly 故 2-4 句即可） ├─ 二、首段框架 │ ├─ 描图三层思考：①描图目的（引出 intended meaning，可借中文标题） │ │ ②描写什么（主体 + 环境 + 动作；类型 人/物；数量 1/2/多/群；关系 相似/对比） │ │ ③用英文怎么描图 │ ├─ 四句框架：第1句总体描述 → 第2-3句细节描述 → 第4句文字说明 │ ├─ 第1句三式：This drawing vividly portrays... / As is vividly depicted in the picture, ... │ │ / Shown in the picture is a (vivid) scene in which ... │ ├─ 过渡语：To be specific, / As can be noticed, / Strangely·Ironically, │ ├─ 文字说明：The caption reads, "..." / Just as the title goes, "..." │ └─ 双主体衔接：相似主体（In the first photo... Similarly·Meanwhile...） │ 主体对比（On the contrary·In contrast / 句1, while 句2） ├─ 例题一 单主体（终点又是新起点）：基本描述 → 加修饰 → 提升用词(rush) → 套框架 → 续寓意 ├─ 例题二 双主体（半瓶水）：拆解（场景 + 主体动作状态） │ ├─ 一个主体多个动作 → ①并列 ②分词表伴随 │ ├─ 第1句：...two men show different attitudes when they see... │ └─ 升级链：基础版 → 加神态 → 换动词(complain) → 加动作+分词伴随+In contrast ├─ 演练：油灯（a little lamp…bright light in the vast darkness + The caption reads…） │ 温室花朵（As is depicted…, Noticeably…despite…, In contrast, it withers…） ├─ 提分要点一 用词优化（多"色彩"） │ ├─ 增加修饰语：名词前后加修饰成分 / 副词·介词短语修饰动词 │ └─ 提升用词：say frustratedly→complain、run→rush·dash、dies→withers、be reading→be dedicated to └─ 提分要点二 运用丰富语法结构（整合分句） ├─ ①状语从句省略形式（引导词 + 形容词/介词短语/分词短语；主语须相同） ├─ ②介词短语（with）做状语（表伴随） ├─ ③分词短语做状语（一个主体多动作 / 不同主体伴随） └─ ④定语从句（并列短句挂到名词上）——四者共用：整合分句，句子更简洁 高频表达速查 ： 用途 表达 :--- :--- 这幅画生动描绘了…… This (set of) drawing(s) vividly portrays + 主体 + who/which + is/are doing sth. 如图所绘（首段首选） As is vividly depicted in the picture / cartoon, ... 图中是一个……的场景 Shown in the picture is a (vivid) scene in which ... 具体说来 To be specific, 可以看出 As can be noticed, 奇怪的是 / 讽刺的是 Strangely / Ironically, 文字说明是…… The caption reads, "..." 正如标题所说 Just as the title goes, "..." 两个人态度不同 two men show different attitudes / have different responses when they see ... 显著的是 Noticeably, 相反（对比过渡） In contrast, / On the contrary, 相似地 / 同时（相似主体） Similarly, / Meanwhile, in the second picture, ... 而（表对比，连接两句） 句 1, while 句 2. 瓶子躺在地上，水正流出 a bottle lying on the ground with water flowing out 手捂着脸 with a hand covering his face 伸手去拿 reaching for sth. 捂着脸并抱怨 covers his face with a hand and complains 当暴露在暴风雨中时（省略） When exposed to the storm, ... 山上有座庙，庙里住着和尚 a mountain on which there is a temple, where a monk lives 专心读书 be dedicated to reading / be concentrating on reading 枯萎 wither 冲、奔 rush / dash 抱怨 complain 大儿子 the eldest son 话题词块备份 ：a young man rushing on the track towards the finishing line（跑道上全力冲刺的年轻人）、One end is another start（终点又是新起点）、two men show different attitudes（两人态度不同）、a lamp giving off bright light in the vast darkness（黑暗中发亮的小灯）、Love is like a lamp, which is brighter in darker places（爱心是一盏灯，越黑暗越明亮）、a flower in full bloom under the protection of the greenhouse（温室中盛开的花）、it withers in the storm（在暴风雨中枯萎）。
